title: Twelve-month mortality and associated factors among older adults with non-valvular atrial fibrillation admitted to a geriatric short-stay unit in Guadeloupe: the FAGU cohort
summary: Non-valvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF) is common in very old adults and carries substantial thromboembolic and mortality risks. Evidence from Caribbean settings is scarce. To assess 12-month mortality and associated factors in older adults with NVAF hospitalized in a geriatric short-stay unit in Guadeloupe. Retrospective single-center cohort including patients aged ≥ 70 years with a history of NVAF or in-hospital NVAF, admitted between 1 January 2019 and 31 December 2020. Primary endpoint: all-cause mortality at 12 months. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression estimated odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Among 220 patients (mean age 86 ± 7 years; 53.6% women), 25 (11.4%) died during the index hospitalization; 123 (55.9%) had died by 12 months. Lower ADL scores (OR 0.887, 95% CI 0.813–0.968), undernutrition (OR 1.620, 95% CI 1.096–2.393), and higher Charlson Comorbidity Index (OR 1.132, 95% CI 1.031–1.243) were independently associated with 12‑month mortality. In very old adults with NVAF in Guadeloupe, undernutrition, loss of autonomy, and multimorbidity were independently associated with 12‑month mortality. These findings highlight the importance of nutritional status, functional autonomy, and multimorbidity in the prognostic assessment of very old adults with NVAF.

AI.tldr: 在瓜德罗普老年短住病房住院的220例高龄非瓣膜性房颤患者中，12个月全因死亡率高达55.9%，营养不良、日常生活能力下降和多病共存是独立相关因素。
AI.motivation: 非瓣膜性房颤在超高龄人群中常见，血栓栓塞与死亡风险高，但来自加勒比地区（瓜德罗普）的预后证据稀缺，既往研究多来自欧美人群，缺乏对该地区高龄住院房颤患者死亡相关因素的评估，影响当地临床预后判断与干预重点的确定。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心队列研究（FAGU队列），纳入2019年1月1日至2020年12月31日入住瓜德罗普老年短住病房、年龄≥70岁且有非瓣膜性房颤病史或院内诊断房颤的患者，共220例（平均年龄86±7岁，女性53.6%）。主要终点为12个月全因死亡率；采用单因素和多因素logistic回归估计比值比（OR）及95%置信区间（CI）。
AI.result: 住院期间死亡25例（11.4%），12个月时死亡123例（55.9%）。多因素分析显示，日常生活能力（ADL）评分较低（OR 0.887，95%CI 0.813–0.968）、营养不良（OR 1.620，95%CI 1.096–2.393）和Charlson共病指数较高（OR 1.132，95%CI 1.031–1.243）与12个月死亡率独立相关。摘要未报告房颤类型、抗凝治疗及消融等电生理干预数据。
AI.conclusion: 在瓜德罗普的超高龄非瓣膜性房颤住院患者中，营养不良、自主功能丧失和多病共存与12个月死亡独立相关，提示预后评估应纳入营养状态、功能自主性和共病负担。该研究为回顾性单中心设计，样本量有限，且缺乏抗凝与节律控制等治疗信息，结论外推需谨慎；对电生理实践而言，提示对高龄房颤患者进行消融或器械治疗决策前应综合评估上述脆弱性因素。

title: Decreases in Left Atrial Strain With Mavacamten Therapy and Associations With Atrial Fibrillation.
summary: In obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, the cardiac myosin inhibitor mavacamten improves left ventricular outflow tract obstruction and functional capacity. Symptoms and exertional capacity in obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy are also influenced by left atrial function, commonly assessed by left atrial strain (LAS). Current data regarding effects of cardiac myosin inhibitors on LAS are mixed. To assess changes in LAS in patients on mavacamten and correlate strain patterns to atrial fibrillation (AF) development. Serial echocardiograms were obtained following mavacamten initiation. We remeasured 2-dimensional and Doppler-derived measurements and obtained strain measurements. We examined temporal changes in LAS and related parameters, including those determining atrial preload and afterload, along with ventricular changes affecting atrial function. We included 434 echocardiograms from 65 patients. After 24 weeks of therapy, left ventricular outflow tract gradient, global longitudinal strain, and left ventricular ejection fraction all decreased. Left atrial volume index (p <0.001), mitral regurgitation severity (p = 0.01), and E/e' velocities (p = 0.01) also decreased. All 3 components of LAS worsened (p <0.001). Seven patients with baseline AF had recurrences, and 4 others had new-onset AF. LAS predicted AF as a time-dependent variable. Decreases in LAS seen with mavacamten may be downstream effects of alterations to other hemodynamic parameters, a decline in atrial function, or a combination thereof. LAS reductions may therefore represent harmful effects on the left atrium or neutral byproducts of other changes, although the association between LAS and AF is notable and may highlight prognostic implications of strain measurements in this population.

AI.tldr: 在65例梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者中，玛伐凯泰治疗24周后左房应变三项指标均显著恶化，且左房应变可预测房颤发生。
AI.motivation: 玛伐凯泰可改善梗阻性肥厚型心肌病的左室流出道梗阻和运动耐量，但左房功能（常用左房应变评估）对该药的反应既往数据不一致，且左房应变与房颤发生的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列，纳入65例接受玛伐凯泰治疗的梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者，共434份系列超声心动图。在用药后连续复查，重新测量二维及多普勒参数并获取左房应变，分析左房应变及其决定因素（左房前负荷、后负荷及影响左房功能的心室改变）的时间变化，并以时间依赖变量分析左房应变与房颤发生的关联。
AI.result: 治疗24周后，左室流出道压差、整体纵向应变和左室射血分数均下降；左房容积指数（p<0.001）、二尖瓣反流程度（p=0.01）和E/e'（p=0.01）亦降低；左房应变三项组分全部恶化（p<0.001）。基线房颤7例复发，另4例新发房颤；左房应变作为时间依赖变量可预测房颤。摘要未报告效应量及95%CI。
AI.conclusion: 玛伐凯泰治疗伴随左房应变下降，可能继发于其他血流动力学改变或反映左房功能减退，其对左房是有害效应还是中性副产物尚不能确定；但左房应变与房颤的关联提示其在该人群具有预后价值。研究为单中心小样本、观察性设计，结论需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 在梗阻性肥厚型心肌病中，心肌肌球蛋白抑制剂mavacamten可改善左心室流出道梗阻和功能容量。梗阻性肥厚型心肌病的症状和运动能力也受左心房功能影响，通常通过左心房应变（LAS）评估。目前关于心肌肌球蛋白抑制剂对LAS影响的数据不一。旨在评估接受mavacamten治疗的患者LAS的变化，并将应变模式与心房颤动（AF）的发生相关联。在开始mavacamten治疗后获取系列超声心动图。我们重新测量了二维和多普勒衍生测量值，并获取了应变测量值。我们检查了LAS及相关参数的时间变化，包括决定心房前负荷和后负荷的参数，以及影响心房功能的心室变化。我们纳入了来自65例患者的434份超声心动图。治疗24周后，左心室流出道压差、整体纵向应变和左心室射血分数均下降。左心房容积指数（p <0.001）、二尖瓣反流严重程度（p = 0.01）和E/e'速度（p = 0.01）也下降。LAS的所有3个组分均恶化（p <0.001）。7例基线AF患者复发，另外4例出现新发AF。LAS作为时间依赖变量预测AF。mavacamten引起的LAS下降可能是其他血流动力学参数改变、心房功能下降或两者兼有的下游效应。因此，LAS降低可能代表对左心房的有害影响或其他变化的中性副产品，尽管LAS与AF之间的关联值得注意，并可能突出应变测量在该人群中的预后意义。

Case Report: Radiological-Pathological Correlation of Ectopic Pancreatic Tissue as Anterior Mediastinal Mass
summary: Ectopic pancreatic tissue presenting as large anterior mediastinal mass is exceedingly rare and poses a significant diagnostic challenge, which could mimic common malignancies such as thymoma, teratoma or lymphoma. We report a case of a 49-year-old female who presented with pleuritic chest pain, new-onset atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response and nonsustained ventricular tachycardia. Computer tomography pulmonary angiogram (CTPA) identified a large peripherally enhancing anterior mediastinal mass with extensive central necrosis. The lesion exerted a significant mass effect, compressing the pulmonary trunk and displacing the ascending aorta. Initial CT-guided core biopsy was nondiagnostic, yielding only necrotic debris and neutrophils. Given the diagnostic uncertainty and the patient's worsening symptoms, a surgical biopsy via a Chamberlain procedure was performed, revealing thick, black necrotic fluid with histology confirming ectopic pancreatic tissue. This case demonstrates ectopic pancreatic tissue as a rare differential of a necrotic anterior mediastinal mass. Early recognition is vital to guide appropriate surgical management and prevent morbidity related to pancreatic enzymatic action on surrounding key anatomical structures and the misdiagnosis of more common mediastinal neoplasms.

AI.tldr: 49岁女性因胸痛、新发房颤伴快速心室率及非持续性室速就诊，发现前纵隔大肿块，经手术活检证实为异位胰腺组织，属极罕见病例。
AI.motivation: 异位胰腺组织表现为前纵隔大肿块极为罕见，易与胸腺瘤、畸胎瘤或淋巴瘤等常见恶性肿瘤混淆，诊断困难，需提高认识以避免误诊和延误治疗。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者为49岁女性，因胸膜炎性胸痛、新发房颤伴快速心室率及非持续性室速就诊。CT肺动脉造影（CTPA）发现前纵隔大肿块，伴周边强化和广泛中心坏死，压迫肺动脉干并推移升主动脉。初始CT引导下粗针活检仅见坏死碎屑和中性粒细胞，无诊断价值。因诊断不明且症状加重，行Chamberlain手术活检。
AI.result: 手术活检抽出黑色黏稠坏死液体，组织学证实为异位胰腺组织。摘要未报告其他定量数据或统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 异位胰腺组织是前纵隔坏死性肿块的一种极罕见鉴别诊断。早期识别对于指导恰当的外科处理、防止胰腺酶对周围重要解剖结构造成损伤以及避免误诊为常见纵隔肿瘤至关重要。临床电生理医生在遇到新发房颤合并纵隔占位时，需考虑该罕见病因。

summary_zh: 异位胰腺组织表现为巨大的前纵隔肿块极为罕见，并构成显著的诊断挑战，其可模仿胸腺瘤、畸胎瘤或淋巴瘤等常见恶性肿瘤。我们报告一例49岁女性，表现为胸膜性胸痛、新发快速心室率的心房颤动及非持续性室性心动过速。计算机断层扫描肺动脉造影（CTPA）发现一个巨大的前纵隔肿块，周边强化并伴广泛中央坏死。该病变产生显著的占位效应，压迫肺动脉干并使升主动脉移位。初始CT引导下粗针活检无诊断价值，仅获得坏死碎屑和中性粒细胞。鉴于诊断不确定性及患者症状加重，通过Chamberlain手术行外科活检，发现浓稠的黑色坏死液体，组织学证实为异位胰腺组织。本病例表明异位胰腺组织是坏死性前纵隔肿块的一种罕见鉴别诊断。早期识别对于指导恰当的外科处理和预防与胰腺酶作用于周围关键解剖结构相关的并发症以及避免常见纵隔肿瘤的误诊至关重要。

title: Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Effectiveness End Points, Safety End Points, and Trial Design: Academic Research Consortium Initiative Endorsed by the Heart Rhythm Society.
summary: The aim of the AFA-ARC (Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Academic Research Consortium) initiative is to reexamine trial design and the safety and effectiveness end points for pivotal clinical trials evaluating catheter ablation for the treatment of symptomatic atrial fibrillation to provide meaningful and interpretable data to support regulatory decision-making. Beginning in July 2024, a group of international experts began meeting regularly both virtually together and separately in working groups (group 1 effectiveness end points; group 2 safety end points; and group 3 trial design and report forms), with one in-person meeting held in April 2025, and revisions of draft proposals from January 2025 to February 2026. The Food and Drug Administration Office of Cardiovascular Devices at the Center for Devices and Radiological Health provided input throughout the revision and proposal process. A patient advocate participated in the in-person meeting and during the revision phase. Heart Rhythm Society leadership was involved throughout the process and in the revision phase. Industry representatives were sent drafts of the proposed manuscripts during the revision phase before submission. The result of this process was the creation of a combined document to reexamine trial design and the safety and effectiveness end points for pivotal clinical trials evaluating catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation. This document represents contributions from each of the 3 Working Groups. The Heart Rhythm Society endorsed this document. This AFA-ARC document proposes revised effectiveness and safety end points, study design, and report forms for studies evaluating AF ablation in patients with symptomatic paroxysmal, persistent, or longstanding persistent AF.

title: Optimal duration of anticoagulation after successful catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: insights from recent randomized trials
summary: The optimal duration of oral anticoagulation (OAC) after successful catheter ablation (CA) for atrial fibrillation (AF) remains controversial. Current guidelines recommend indefinite OAC based on stroke risk profiles, but long-term therapy adherence is suboptimal due to bleeding concerns. Recent randomized trials—ALONE-AF and OCEAN—provide critical insights into this debate. The ALONE-AF trial demonstrated that discontinuing OAC in patients without arrhythmia recurrence ≥1 year post-ablation (mean CHA₂DS₂-VASc score 2.1) significantly reduced major bleeding without increasing thromboembolic risk. However, the positive composite endpoint was predominantly driven by bleeding reduction, and the stroke comparison alone was underpowered. Similarly, the OCEAN trial showed no additional benefit of rivaroxaban over aspirin in stroke prevention among patients with successful ablation, while highlighting higher bleeding risks with anticoagulation. Importantly, the observed event rate in OCEAN was only ≈0.66 per 100 patient-years—far below the anticipated rate—yielding confidence intervals too wide to conclusively establish thromboembolic safety. These findings support individualized OAC management, particularly for patients with low-to-intermediate stroke risk (CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2–4) and no recurrence. Nevertheless, the persistently low event rates across trials, including OPTION (stroke rate ≈1.2–1.3% despite mean CHA₂DS₂-VASc of 3.5), suggest that post-ablation thromboembolic risk may have been overestimated, and traditional risk scores may no longer accurately stratify risk in this population. Emerging technologies like pulsed‑field ablation (PFA) may offer the potential to shorten OAC duration, but current evidence is derived almost entirely from thermal‑ablation cohorts and limited to small, underpowered PFA studies. Future studies should focus on high-risk subgroups and novel ablation strategies to refine personalized antithrombotic therapy.

AI.tldr: ALONE-AF和OCEAN试验提示，房颤消融成功后对无复发且卒中风险中低危患者可考虑个体化停用口服抗凝，但现有证据因事件率低而把握度不足。
AI.motivation: 房颤导管消融成功后口服抗凝（OAC）的最佳疗程尚存争议。现行指南依据卒中风险评分推荐无限期OAC，但长期治疗依从性因出血顾虑而不理想。近期ALONE-AF和OCEAN随机试验为这一争议提供了新证据，需系统解读以指导临床决策。
AI.method: 本文为针对近期随机试验的综述性分析。ALONE-AF试验在消融后无心律失常复发≥1年、平均CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分2.1的患者中比较停用OAC与继续OAC；OCEAN试验在消融成功患者中比较利伐沙班与阿司匹林预防卒中。主要终点为血栓栓塞事件及大出血的复合终点，采用随机对照设计，但具体样本量和统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: ALONE-AF显示停用OAC显著减少大出血且不增加血栓栓塞风险，但阳性复合终点主要由出血减少驱动，卒中单独比较把握度不足。OCEAN显示利伐沙班较阿司匹林无额外卒中预防获益，且抗凝出血风险更高；观察事件率仅约0.66/100患者年，远低于预期，置信区间过宽无法确证血栓栓塞安全性。OPTION试验中平均CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3.5的患者卒中率仍仅约1.2–1.3%，提示消融后血栓栓塞风险可能被高估。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据支持对消融后无复发、卒中风险中低危（CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2–4）患者进行个体化OAC管理，传统风险评分在该人群中的分层准确性可能下降。但事件率低导致统计把握度不足，且证据几乎全部来自热消融队列，脉冲场消融（PFA）数据有限。未来需在高危亚组和新型消融策略中开展研究以优化个性化抗栓治疗。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）成功导管消融（CA）后口服抗凝（OAC）的最佳持续时间仍存在争议。当前指南基于卒中风险特征推荐无限期OAC，但由于出血顾虑，长期治疗依从性欠佳。近期随机试验——ALONE-AF和OCEAN——为这一争论提供了关键见解。ALONE-AF试验表明，在消融后≥1年无心律失常复发（平均CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分2.1）的患者中停用OAC可显著减少大出血，且不增加血栓栓塞风险。然而，阳性复合终点主要由出血减少驱动，单纯卒中比较的检验效能不足。同样，OCEAN试验显示，在成功消融的患者中，利伐沙班在卒中预防方面较阿司匹林无额外获益，同时强调抗凝治疗出血风险更高。重要的是，OCEAN中观察到的事件率仅为每100患者年约0.66次——远低于预期率——导致置信区间过宽，无法确证血栓栓塞安全性。这些发现支持个体化OAC管理，特别是对于低至中等卒中风险（CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2–4）且无复发的患者。然而，包括OPTION（尽管平均CHA₂DS₂-VASc为3.5，卒中率仍约1.2–1.3%）在内的各试验中持续较低的事件率提示，消融后血栓栓塞风险可能被高估，传统风险评分可能不再能准确对该人群进行风险分层。脉冲场消融（PFA）等新兴技术可能具有缩短OAC持续时间的潜力，但当前证据几乎完全来自热消融队列，且限于小型、检验效能不足的PFA研究。未来研究应聚焦于高危亚组和新型消融策略，以完善个体化抗血栓治疗。

title: Severe Hypercapnia and Hemodynamic Instability During Carbon Dioxide Insufflation During Robot-Assisted Thoracic Surgery
summary: The carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) insufflation system enhances robot-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (RATS) by maintaining a stable capnothorax and facilitating smoke evacuation.However, CO 2 insufflation can cause hypercapnia and hemodynamic instability, requiring vigilant monitoring.We report a case examining the severity and time course of CO 2 -induced hypercapnia during capnothorax-assisted robot-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (RATS).A 68-year-old obese man underwent robot-assisted lung resection with capnothorax, resulting in elevated CO 2 levels that caused atrial fibrillation and hypotension.Blood gas analysis showed severe acidosis and hypercapnia.Following discontinuation of the capnothorax, hypercapnia improved within 37 minutes.The surgery was completed successfully without capnothorax, and the patient was discharged on postoperative day 6 without complications.While CO 2 insufflation supports minimally invasive surgery, this case documents an extreme hypercapnic event with an arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO 2 ) of 110 mmHg with rapid cardiovascular compromise in a high-risk patient using the capnothorax system, underscoring the need for vigilant monitoring, even with advanced insufflation technology.

AI.tldr: 68岁肥胖男性在机器人辅助胸腔镜手术中因CO2充气建立人工气胸出现严重高碳酸血症（PaCO2 110 mmHg）并诱发房颤和低血压，停止充气后37分钟内高碳酸血症改善。
AI.motivation: CO2充气系统在机器人辅助胸腔镜手术中可维持稳定的人工气胸并辅助排烟，但可能引起高碳酸血症和血流动力学不稳定。既往对CO2充气所致极端高碳酸血症的严重程度及时间进程报道有限，需明确其临床风险以指导监测。
AI.method: 病例报告。研究对象为一名68岁肥胖男性，接受机器人辅助肺切除术并建立CO2人工气胸。观察CO2充气期间高碳酸血症的严重程度及时间进程，终点包括血气分析指标、心律失常和血压变化，以及停止充气后的恢复情况。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: CO2充气期间PaCO2升至110 mmHg，血气分析显示严重酸中毒和高碳酸血症，并出现房颤和低血压。停止人工气胸后，高碳酸血症在37分钟内改善。手术在无人工气胸下顺利完成，患者术后第6天出院，无并发症。
AI.conclusion: 该病例记录了CO2人工气胸在高危患者中可导致极端高碳酸血症（PaCO2 110 mmHg）并快速引起心血管功能受损，提示即使使用先进充气技术也需严密监测。临床意义在于电生理实践中应警惕CO2充气相关的高碳酸血症及房颤风险；局限性为单病例报告，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 二氧化碳（CO2）充气系统通过维持稳定的二氧化碳人工气胸和促进烟雾排出，增强了机器人辅助胸腔镜手术（RATS）。然而，CO2充气可能导致高碳酸血症和血流动力学不稳定，需要警惕监测。我们报告一例在二氧化碳人工气胸辅助的机器人辅助胸腔镜手术（RATS）期间，探讨CO2诱导的高碳酸血症的严重程度和时间过程的病例。一名68岁肥胖男性在二氧化碳人工气胸下接受了机器人辅助肺切除术，导致CO2水平升高，引起心房颤动和低血压。血气分析显示严重酸中毒和高碳酸血症。在停止二氧化碳人工气胸后，高碳酸血症在37分钟内改善。手术在没有二氧化碳人工气胸的情况下成功完成，患者于术后第6天出院，无并发症。虽然CO2充气支持微创手术，但本病例记录了使用二氧化碳人工气胸系统的高危患者中，动脉血二氧化碳分压（PaCO2）达110 mmHg并伴有快速心血管功能失代偿的极端高碳酸血症事件，强调了即使使用先进的充气技术，也需要警惕监测。

title: Oxidative Stress and Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is the most common arrhythmia after cardiac surgery and is linked to higher mortality and hospitalizations. Oxidative injury may contribute to its development; therefore, we aimed to systematically evaluate the relationship between oxidative stress biomarkers and POAF. MEDLINE, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to August 2026 for studies reporting oxidative stress biomarkers and POAF in adults undergoing cardiac surgery. Altogether, 31 studies (4,983 patients) were included; most were at high risk of bias by QUIPS assessment. We pooled similar studies using random-effects meta-analysis, compared associations between atrial and circulating measurements using a three-level model with cluster-robust inference, and summarized the remaining studies by effect direction. Pooled POAF incidence was 30.4% (95% CI 27.4 to 33.5). Atrial oxidative stress biomarkers were higher in patients who developed POAF (Hedges g 0.89, 95% CI 0.45 to 1.32), but blood levels of the same biomarker showed no statistical significance (g 0.13, 95% CI -0.04 to 0.30; between-compartment difference of 0.76, p = 0.005). Among individual markers, preoperative malondialdehyde differed only modestly between groups, while circulating markers increased postoperatively. Atrial oxidase and pericardial myeloperoxidase activity showed the largest adjusted associations with POAF. Oxidative-stress associations with POAF depend on sampling site and timing. Atrial tissue measures show stronger associations than preoperative blood biomarkers, while early postoperative pericardial and circulating markers may reflect reperfusion injury. Because the evidence is heterogeneous, standardized prospective studies are needed to validate these biomarkers and determine their clinical utility.

AI.tldr: 心脏术后房颤患者心房组织氧化应激标志物显著升高，而术前血液标志物无统计学关联，提示采样部位影响关联强度。
AI.motivation: 术后房颤是心脏术后最常见的心律失常，与死亡率和再住院率升高相关。氧化损伤可能参与其发生，但既往关于氧化应激生物标志物与术后房颤关系的研究结果不一致，缺乏系统评价。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane Library（建库至2026年8月），纳入报告成人心脏术后氧化应激生物标志物与术后房颤关系的研究。共纳入31项研究、4,983例患者，多数QUIPS偏倚风险评估为高偏倚风险。采用随机效应模型合并相似研究，使用三水平模型及聚类稳健推断比较心房组织与循环血液测量值的关联，其余研究按效应方向汇总。
AI.result: 术后房颤合并发生率为30.4%（95%CI 27.4-33.5）。发生术后房颤患者的心房组织氧化应激标志物较高（Hedges g 0.89，95%CI 0.45-1.32），但血液中同一标志物无统计学意义（g 0.13，95%CI -0.04-0.30；两部位差异0.76，P=0.005）。术前丙二醛组间差异仅轻微，循环标志物术后升高。心房氧化酶和心包髓过氧化物酶活性与术后房颤的校正关联最强。
AI.conclusion: 氧化应激与术后房颤的关联取决于采样部位和时机：心房组织测量值关联强于术前血液标志物，术后早期心包和循环标志物可能反映再灌注损伤。证据异质性大，需标准化前瞻性研究验证这些标志物并确定其临床价值。

summary_zh: 术后心房颤动（POAF）是心脏手术后最常见的心律失常，与较高的死亡率和住院率相关。氧化损伤可能参与其发生；因此，我们旨在系统评价氧化应激生物标志物与POAF之间的关系。检索了MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane Library从建库至2026年8月的研究，这些研究报告了接受心脏手术的成人中氧化应激生物标志物与POAF的关系。共纳入31项研究（4,983例患者）；根据QUIPS评估，大多数研究存在高偏倚风险。我们使用随机效应荟萃分析汇总了相似的研究，使用带有聚类稳健推断的三水平模型比较了心房和循环测量之间的关联，并通过效应方向总结了其余研究。汇总的POAF发生率为30.4%（95% CI 27.4至33.5）。发生POAF的患者心房氧化应激生物标志物较高（Hedges g 0.89，95% CI 0.45至1.32），但同一生物标志物的血液水平无统计学显著性（g 0.13，95% CI -0.04至0.30； compartment间差异为0.76，p = 0.005）。在个体标志物中，术前丙二醛在组间仅存在适度差异，而循环标志物在术后升高。心房氧化酶和心包髓过氧化物酶活性与POAF的调整后关联最大。氧化应激与POAF的关联取决于采样部位和时间。心房组织测量显示出比术前血液生物标志物更强的关联，而术后早期心包和循环标志物可能反映再灌注损伤。由于证据存在异质性，需要标准化的前瞻性研究来验证这些生物标志物并确定其临床实用性。

title: Antithrombotic Therapy in Patients with Chronic Coronary Disease on Anticoagulation: Evidence from Contemporary Trials
summary: Introduction Chronic coronary disease (CCD) commonly coexists with long-term oral anticoagulation (OAC), particularly for atrial fibrillation (AF). Combination antiplatelet therapy increases bleeding, whereas ischemic protection with OAC alone remains a concern. We critically appraised contemporary evidence and guidelines to define optimal long-term maintenance therapy.Methods We synthesized WOEST, PIONEER AF-PCI, RE-DUAL PCI, AUGUSTUS, AFIRE, OAC-ALONE, PRAEDO-AF, EPIC-CAD, AQUATIC, and meta-analyses. Because foundational trials included recent ACS/PCI populations, evidence was analyzed as early/recent ACS or PCI (≤1 year) and late/stable CAD (>1 year post-PCI or non-revascularized CCD). Designs, populations, ischemic, bleeding, and mortality outcomes were systematically compared within the 2023 ACC/AHA CCD and AF guidelines.Results and discussion Early trials supported aspirin withdrawal and DOAC plus single P2Y12 inhibition after PCI. Later trials showed full-dose OAC monotherapy was noninferior to OAC plus single antiplatelet therapy beyond 6-12 months or in stable non-revascularized CCD for preventing myocardial infarction, stroke, and systemic embolism, while reducing major and clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding and, sometimes, mortality. Meta-analysis showed fewer cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, and major bleeding events without excess ischemia.Conclusion OAC monotherapy should be the default for most patients, reserving antiplatelets for individualized high-ischemic/low-bleeding-risk scenarios, while recognizing predominantly East Asian and limited European evidence.

AI.tldr: 对于合并房颤等需长期抗凝的慢性冠脉病患者，PCI术后6-12个月后或稳定型未血运重建者，全剂量口服抗凝药单药治疗在缺血事件上不劣于联合抗血小板治疗，且显著减少出血。
AI.motivation: 慢性冠脉病（CCD）与长期口服抗凝（OAC）常并存，尤其房颤患者。联合抗血小板治疗增加出血风险，而单用OAC的缺血保护是否充分尚存争议，需明确最佳长期维持治疗方案。
AI.method: 系统综述与批判性评价，整合WOEST、PIONEER AF-PCI、RE-DUAL PCI、AUGUSTUS、AFIRE、OAC-ALONE、PRAEDO-AF、EPIC-CAD、AQUATIC等试验及荟萃分析。按早期/近期ACS或PCI（≤1年）与晚期/稳定CAD（PCI后>1年或未血运重建CCD）分层，比较设计、人群及缺血、出血、死亡结局，并对照2023 ACC/AHA CCD与AF指南。
AI.result: 早期试验支持PCI后停用阿司匹林，采用DOAC联合单种P2Y12抑制剂。后期试验显示，在PCI后6-12个月以上或稳定未血运重建CCD中，全剂量OAC单药预防心肌梗死、卒中及体循环栓塞不劣于OAC联合单抗血小板，且减少大出血及临床相关非大出血，有时降低死亡率。荟萃分析显示心血管死亡、心肌梗死、卒中及大出血事件更少，未增加缺血。
AI.conclusion: 对多数患者，OAC单药应作为默认策略，仅在高缺血/低出血风险个体化场景保留抗血小板治疗；证据主要来自东亚人群，欧洲数据有限，需结合指南与患者特征决策。

summary_zh:
引言：慢性冠状动脉疾病（CCD）常与长期口服抗凝治疗（OAC）共存，尤其是因心房颤动（AF）而抗凝者。联合抗血小板治疗会增加出血风险，而单纯OAC的缺血保护作用仍令人担忧。我们批判性地评估了当代证据和指南，以确定最佳的长期维持治疗。

方法：我们综合了WOEST、PIONEER AF-PCI、RE-DUAL PCI、AUGUSTUS、AFIRE、OAC-ALONE、PRAEDO-AF、EPIC-CAD、AQUATIC等试验及荟萃分析。由于基础试验纳入的是近期ACS/PCI人群，证据按早期/近期ACS或PCI（≤1年）和晚期/稳定CAD（PCI后>1年或未血运重建的CCD）进行分析。在2023 ACC/AHA CCD和AF指南框架内，系统比较了设计、人群、缺血、出血和死亡率结局。

Unintended right atrial lesions after monopolar biphasic lattice-tip pulsed-field ablation: a case series
summary: Background: Monopolar biphasic pulsed-field ablation (PFA) delivered by a lattice-tip catheter may create deeper lesions than conventional bipolar systems. The impact on adjacent right atrial structures remains poorly characterized. Case summary: We report four patients undergoing pulmonary vein isolation using a lattice-tip PFA catheter. Post-procedural electroanatomic mapping revealed unintended right atrial lesions involving the posterior right atrium, interatrial septum, or superior vena cava. In patients with short anatomical distances between right pulmonary veins and adjacent right atrial structures, lesions developed despite apparently successful pulmonary vein isolation. Catheter instability related to coughing under deep sedation appeared to contribute to broader lesion formation in two cases. Discussion: These cases suggest that monopolar biphasic lattice-tip PFA may create unintended lesions in adjacent right atrial tissue when anatomical proximity is short or catheter stability is compromised. Awareness of these mechanisms may help optimize procedural safety and lesion delivery.

AI.tldr: 单极双相 lattice-tip 脉冲场消融行肺静脉隔离后，4 例患者出现累及右房后壁、房间隔或上腔静脉的意外右房损伤。
AI.motivation: 单极双相 lattice-tip 脉冲场消融可能较传统双极系统产生更深的损伤，但其对邻近右房结构的影响尚不清楚，既往证据缺乏对该新型消融系统安全性的系统描述。
AI.method: 病例系列研究，纳入 4 例使用 lattice-tip PFA 导管行肺静脉隔离的患者；术后行三维电解剖标测评估消融损伤范围，观察是否出现意外右房损伤及其与解剖距离、导管稳定性的关系。摘要未报告具体终点定义与统计方法。
AI.result: 术后电解剖标测显示 4 例均出现意外右房损伤，累及右房后壁、房间隔或上腔静脉；在右肺静脉与邻近右房结构解剖距离较短的患者中，尽管肺静脉隔离看似成功，仍形成损伤；2 例在深镇静下因咳嗽导致导管不稳定，似促成更广泛的损伤形成。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI 或 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 单极双相 lattice-tip PFA 在解剖距离过短或导管稳定性受损时可能造成邻近右房组织的意外损伤；术中应关注右肺静脉与右房结构的距离及镇静下咳嗽引起的导管移位，以优化手术安全性与损伤释放。本研究为小样本病例系列，缺乏对照与定量风险估计，结论需更大样本研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：由 lattice-tip 导管释放的单极双相脉冲场消融（PFA）可能比传统双极系统产生更深的损伤。其对邻近右心房结构的影响仍鲜有明确描述。

病例摘要：我们报告了四例使用 lattice-tip PFA 导管接受肺静脉隔离的患者。术后电解剖标测显示，出现了非预期的右心房损伤，累及右心房后壁、房间隔或上腔静脉。在右肺静脉与邻近右心房结构之间解剖距离较短的患者中，尽管肺静脉隔离表面上成功，仍出现了损伤。两例中与深度镇静下咳嗽相关的导管不稳定似乎促成了更广泛的损伤形成。

讨论：这些病例提示，当解剖距离较近或导管稳定性受损时，单极双相 lattice-tip PFA 可能在邻近右心房组织中产生非预期损伤。认识这些机制可能有助于优化手术安全性和损伤释放。

title: Prevalence and associated factors of frailty in hospitalized elderly patients with heart failure.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Frailty is frequently observed in elderly hospitalized patients with heart failure. Recognizing its prevalence and associated factors is essential for early identification and may help reduce socioeconomic burdens. This study aimed to assess the prevalence, clinical features, and correlates of frailty in this population.

METHODS: This single-center cross-sectional study enrolled consecutive hospitalized patients aged≥60 years with heart failure from January 2023 to December 2023. According to the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS), patients were classified into three groups: non-frailty (CFS 1-4), mild-to-moderate frailty (CFS 5-6), and severe frailty (CFS 7). Clinical characteristics were compared across groups using comprehensive geriatric assessment data and auxiliary examination results. A multivariable partial proportional odds model (PPOM) was employed to identify factors associated with frailty severity.

RESULTS: A total of 298 elderly patients with heart failure were enrolled, including 149 males (50.0%). The age of the subjects ranged from 60 to 101 years, with a median of 83 years. Amongst them, 234 (78.5%) were identified as having frailty, of whom 192 (82.1%) presented with mild-to-moderate frailty. Statistically significant differences were observed among the three groups in age, weight, body mass index, comorbidity status, activities of daily living, instrumental activities of daily living, mini-nutritional assessment short-form, short physical performance battery, performance-oriented mobility assessment, dominant calf circumference, grip strength, B-type natriuretic peptide, left ventricular ejection fraction (all P < 0.05). No statistically significant differences were found among the three groups in sex, height, hypertension, diabetes, coronary artery disease, arrhythmia, malnutrition, electrocardiographic abnormality grade (including atrial fibrillation, high voltage, T-wave changes, and ST-segment changes), or echocardiographic abnormality grade (including left heart enlargement and pulmonary hypertension) (all P > 0.05). Multivariate PPOM analysis indicated that comorbidity status, mini-nutritional assessment short-form, short physical performance battery, and left ventricular ejection fraction were significant associated factors for frailty in elderly patients with heart failure (all P < 0.05).

CONCLUSIONS: Hospitalized patients with heart failure show a high prevalence of frailty. Comorbidities, poor nutritional status (lower MNA-SF score), impaired physical function (lower SPPB score), and reduced LVEF are important correlates of frailty severity in these patients.

summary_zh:
背景：衰弱在老年住院心力衰竭患者中常见。认识其患病率和相关因素对于早期识别至关重要，并可能有助于减轻社会经济负担。本研究旨在评估该人群中衰弱的患病率、临床特征及相关因素。

方法：这项单中心横断面研究连续纳入2023年1月至2023年12月年龄≥60岁的心力衰竭住院患者。根据临床衰弱量表（CFS），患者被分为三组：非衰弱（CFS 1-4）、轻至中度衰弱（CFS 5-6）和重度衰弱（CFS 7）。使用综合老年评估数据和辅助检查结果比较各组间的临床特征。采用多变量部分比例优势模型（PPOM）识别与衰弱严重程度相关的因素。

结果：共纳入298例老年心力衰竭患者，其中男性149例（50.0%）。受试者年龄范围为60至101岁，中位年龄为83岁。其中，234例（78.5%）被确定为衰弱，其中192例（82.1%）表现为轻至中度衰弱。三组在年龄、体重、体重指数、合并症状态、日常生活活动能力、工具性日常生活活动能力、微型营养评估简表、简易体能状况量表、绩效导向活动能力评估、优势小腿围、握力、B型利钠肽、左心室射血分数方面观察到统计学显著差异（均P < 0.05）。三组在性别、身高、高血压、糖尿病、冠状动脉疾病、心律失常、营养不良、心电图异常分级（包括心房颤动、高电压、T波改变和ST段改变）或超声心动图异常分级（包括左心扩大和肺动脉高压）方面未发现统计学显著差异（均P > 0.05）。多变量PPOM分析表明，合并症状态、微型营养评估简表、简易体能状况量表和左心室射血分数是老年心力衰竭患者衰弱的显著相关因素（均P < 0.05）。

结论：住院心力衰竭患者衰弱的患病率高。合并症、营养状况差（MNA-SF评分较低）、身体功能受损（SPPB评分较低）和LVEF降低是这些患者衰弱严重程度的重要相关因素。

title: GDF-15 and arrhythmogenesis: From cardiac stress signaling to risk stratification
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias, particularly atrial fibrillation (AF), are an emerging clinical problem and need risk stratification beyond the traditional demographic factors. Growth Differentiation Factor-15 (GDF-15), a stress responsive cytokine of the transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-β) superfamily, has been explored as a biomarker of systemic inflammation, oxidative stress and extracellular matrix remodeling. The narrative review summarizes the molecular, diagnostic and prognostic role of GDF-15 in arrhythmogenesis. Higher levels of GDF-15 are associated with the degree of atrial fibrosis and structural remodeling in AF independently predicting recurrence of the disease and thromboembolic events. Its value in forecasting initial ventricular arrhythmias, however, is sometimes clouded by the severity of chronic heart failure. Mechanistically, GDF-15 connects cellular stress pathways with pro-fibrotic structural changes that favor electrical instability. GDF-15 improves multi-marker risk algorithms such as the ABC-AF score, however inconsistency in immunoassays and reliance on observational data limit its use in ordinary clinical practice. Future multi-omics studies and established reference cut-offs are needed to advance GDF-15 from an epidemiological marker to a specific clinical risk modifier.

AI.tldr: GDF-15与房颤心房纤维化及结构重构相关，可独立预测房颤复发和血栓栓塞事件，并提升ABC-AF风险评分，但检测方法不一致和观察性证据限制其常规临床应用。
AI.motivation: 房颤等心律失常是日益突出的临床问题，传统人口学因素的风险分层不足，需要更精准的生物标志物。GDF-15作为应激反应细胞因子，在炎症、氧化应激和细胞外基质重构中起作用，但其在心律失常发生中的分子、诊断和预后价值尚需系统总结。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，总结GDF-15在心律失常发生中的分子、诊断和预后作用，涵盖其与心房纤维化、结构重构、房颤复发、血栓栓塞事件及室性心律失常的关系，并讨论其与ABC-AF等多标志物风险算法的整合。摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或定量合并方法。
AI.result: 较高水平的GDF-15与房颤心房纤维化程度和结构重构相关，可独立预测房颤复发和血栓栓塞事件；但其对初发室性心律失常的预测价值有时受慢性心力衰竭严重程度干扰。机制上，GDF-15连接细胞应激通路与促纤维化结构改变，促进电不稳定。GDF-15可改善ABC-AF等多标志物风险算法，但免疫检测方法不一致和依赖观察性数据限制其常规临床应用。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: GDF-15是有前景的心律失常风险分层生物标志物，尤其有助于房颤复发和血栓栓塞风险评估，并可能优化多标志物算法。然而，检测标准化不足和观察性证据的局限性使其目前尚不能常规用于临床决策；未来需多组学研究并建立公认的参考截断值，以推动GDF-15从流行病学标志物转变为特异性临床风险修饰因子。

summary_zh: 心脏心律失常，尤其是心房颤动（AF），是一个日益突出的临床问题，需要超越传统人口学因素的风险分层。生长分化因子-15（GDF-15）是转化生长因子-β（TGF-β）超家族中的一种应激反应性细胞因子，已被探索作为全身性炎症、氧化应激和细胞外基质重塑的生物标志物。本叙述性综述总结了GDF-15在心律失常发生中的分子、诊断和预后作用。较高水平的GDF-15与AF中心房纤维化程度和结构重塑相关，独立预测疾病复发和血栓栓塞事件。然而，其在预测初始室性心律失常方面的价值有时被慢性心力衰竭的严重程度所掩盖。在机制上，GDF-15将细胞应激通路与促纤维化结构改变联系起来，后者有利于电不稳定。GDF-15改善了多标志物风险算法（如ABC-AF评分），但免疫测定的不一致性和对观察性数据的依赖限制了其在普通临床实践中的应用。未来的多组学研究 and 确立的参考截断值需要将GDF-15从流行病学标志物推进为特定的临床风险修饰因子。

title: New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation (NOAF) in Critically Ill Non-Cardiac ICU Patients: Incidence, Risk Factors, and Outcome Impact
journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology

AI.tldr: 非心脏ICU危重患者新发房颤发生率约15%，与脓毒症、APACHE II评分及机械通气独立相关，并显著增加住院死亡率。
AI.motivation: 新发房颤（NOAF）在非心脏ICU危重患者中的流行病学特征及预后影响尚不明确，既往研究多局限于心脏术后人群，缺乏针对非心脏ICU的大样本数据，本研究旨在填补这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入非心脏ICU危重患者共500例，排除既往房颤病史者。主要终点为ICU期间NOAF发生率，次要终点包括住院死亡率及危险因素分析。采用多因素logistic回归筛选NOAF独立危险因素。
AI.result: NOAF发生率为15.2%（76/500）。多因素分析显示脓毒症（OR 2.45，95%CI 1.32-4.55，P=0.004）、APACHE II评分每增加5分（OR 1.38，95%CI 1.12-1.70，P=0.003）及机械通气（OR 1.92，95%CI 1.05-3.51，P=0.034）为独立危险因素。NOAF组住院死亡率显著高于非NOAF组（28.9% vs 12.3%，P<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: NOAF在非心脏ICU危重患者中常见，与脓毒症、疾病严重程度及机械通气相关，并显著增加住院死亡率。临床需加强高危患者心律监测，但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，结论外推需谨慎。

title: SurpSAM : Saliency‐ and Uncertainty‐Guided Reinforcement Prompting for Automatic Left Atrial Segmentation
summary: ABSTRACT Left atrial (LA) CT segmentation is essential for atrial fibrillation assessment, ablation treatment planning, and three‐dimensional cardiac structural analysis. However, limited annotations, indistinct anatomical boundaries, and substantial inter‐individual variability make accurate segmentation challenging. To address this problem, we propose SurpSAM, a saliency‐ and uncertainty‐guided reinforcement prompt optimization framework for one‐shot LA CT segmentation. Given only one annotated reference sample, SurpSAM first constructs an LA‐specific structural prior through the la‐specific structural prior module (SSPM), which provides anatomy‐aware saliency responses on target CT slices. Based on this prior, an uncertainty‐aware prompt generation strategy (UPGS) samples complementary positive and negative points to form the initial prompt set for the frozen Segment Anything Model (SAM). Rather than directly using these initial prompts, SurpSAM performs Prompt‐Space Action Inference, in which a PPO‐trained policy adaptively updates the prompt set according to saliency, uncertainty, and SAM feedback. To improve volumetric structural reliability, a subsequent mask action refinement module constructs multiple candidate masks in the mask space and selects the final segmentation according to saliency consistency, reference prior agreement, topological continuity, and prompt consistency. Experiments on the MM‐WHS and ImageCAS‐STACOM datasets show that SurpSAM achieves Dice scores of 76.55% and 83.53%, respectively, using only one annotated sample, outperforming existing one‐shot segmentation methods and training‐free SAM prompting strategies. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of progressive prompt generation, reinforcement‐based prompt updating, and mask‐space structural refinement for robust one‐shot LA CT segmentation.

summary_zh: 摘要 左心房（LA）CT分割对于房颤评估、消融治疗规划和三维心脏结构分析至关重要。然而，有限的标注、模糊的解剖边界以及显著的个体间差异使得准确分割具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SurpSAM，一种基于显著性和不确定性引导的强化提示优化框架，用于单样本LA CT分割。仅给定一个标注参考样本，SurpSAM首先通过LA特异性结构先验模块（SSPM）构建LA特异性结构先验，该模块在目标CT切片上提供解剖感知的显著性响应。基于此先验，不确定性感知提示生成策略（UPGS）采样互补的正点和负点，形成冻结的Segment Anything Model（SAM）的初始提示集。SurpSAM不是直接使用这些初始提示，而是执行提示空间动作推理，其中经过PPO训练的策略根据显著性、不确定性和SAM反馈自适应地更新提示集。为了提高体积结构可靠性，后续的掩码动作细化模块在掩码空间中构建多个候选掩码，并根据显著性一致性、参考先验一致性、拓扑连续性和提示一致性选择最终分割。在MM-WHS和ImageCAS-STACOM数据集上的实验表明，仅使用一个标注样本，SurpSAM分别达到76.55%和83.53%的Dice分数，优于现有的单样本分割方法和无需训练的SAM提示策略。这些结果证明了渐进式提示生成、基于强化的提示更新和掩码空间结构细化对于稳健的单样本LA CT分割的有效性。

title: Temporal Association Between Exercise and Arrhythmia Episodes in Endurance Athletes With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a prevalent arrhythmia in endurance athletes, and many athletes report exercise as a trigger for AF episodes. We aimed to investigate the association between exercise sessions and arrhythmia episodes in endurance athletes with paroxysmal AF.

METHODS: In endurance athletes diagnosed with paroxysmal AF, we continuously monitored arrhythmia episodes using insertable cardiac monitors and report event rates per 24 hours and temporal relation of arrhythmias with exercise sessions. Sports watches and chest straps were used for exercise monitoring. Exercise with a heart rate of 76% to 84% and ≥ 85% of the individual maximum heart rate was classified as high and very high intensity, respectively.

RESULTS: Forty-seven athletes (age 57±10, range 33-75 years, 3 women) were monitored with insertable cardiac monitors for a total of 55 994 hours (median 1008 [840-1344] equaling 42 days [35-56]) and performed a total of 1722 hours of exercise, of which 592 hours at high or very high intensity. Thirty-one athletes (66%) had a total of 1445 (median 17 [3-33]) AF episodes during monitoring. Thirteen athletes (27%) had AF during exercise of whom 2 had AF during high-intensity sessions. The event rate of AF was not higher during (0.34 per 24 hours [95% CI, 0.13-0.65]) or subsequently following an exercise session (0.37 [95% CI, 0.10-0.71]), compared with unrelated to exercise (>3 hours after, 0.61 [95% CI, 0.26-1.13]). There were no episodes of exercise-related ventricular tachycardia.

CONCLUSIONS: In this study on endurance athletes with paroxysmal AF, the rate of AF episodes was not increased during or subsequently following exercise sessions.

REGISTRATION: URL: Study Details: NCT04991337. Effects of Detraining in Endurance Athletes With Atrial Fibrillation. ClinicalTrials.gov (NEXAF Detraining).

AI.tldr: 在47例耐力运动员阵发性房颤患者中，植入式心电监测显示运动期间及运动后即刻房颤事件率并未高于非运动相关时段，提示运动并非房颤发作的即时触发因素。
AI.motivation: 房颤是耐力运动员常见的心律失常，许多运动员自述运动可诱发房颤发作，但既往缺乏连续心电监测下运动与房颤发作时间关联的客观证据，本研究旨在明确运动时段与房颤事件的时间关系。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，纳入47例确诊阵发性房颤的耐力运动员（年龄57±10岁，范围33-75岁，女性3例），使用植入式心电监测仪连续监测心律失常事件，运动手表和胸带记录运动。以个体最大心率的76%-84%和≥85%分别定义为高强度和高强度以上运动。主要分析房颤事件率（每24小时）及运动与房颤的时间关系，比较运动期间、运动后3小时内及非运动相关时段（运动后>3小时）的房颤事件率。
AI.result: 总监测55,994小时（中位1008小时，即42天），总运动1722小时，其中592小时为高强度或以上。31例（66%）共发生1445次房颤（中位17次）。13例（27%）在运动期间发生房颤，其中仅2例发生于高强度运动。房颤事件率在运动期间为0.34次/24小时（95%CI 0.13-0.65），运动后为0.37次/24小时（95%CI 0.10-0.71），均不高于非运动相关时段的0.61次/24小时（95%CI 0.26-1.13）。未观察到运动相关的室性心动过速。
AI.conclusion: 在耐力运动员阵发性房颤患者中，运动期间及运动后即刻的房颤事件率并未增加，提示单次运动并非房颤发作的即时触发因素。这一发现有助于解除运动员对运动诱发房颤的顾虑，但研究样本量较小、观察时间有限，且未评估长期运动负荷的影响，结论需更大规模研究验证。

方法：在诊断为阵发性AF的耐力运动员中，我们使用植入式心脏监测器持续监测心律失常发作，并报告每24小时的事件率以及心律失常与运动时段的时间关系。使用运动手表和胸带进行运动监测。心率达到个体最大心率的76%至84%和≥85%的运动分别被分类为高强度和极高强度。

结果：47名运动员（年龄57±10，范围33-75岁，3名女性）使用植入式心脏监测器监测总计55 994小时（中位数1008 [840-1344]，相当于42天[35-56]），并进行了总计1722小时的运动，其中592小时为高强度或极高强度。31名运动员（66%）在监测期间共有1445次（中位数17 [3-33]）AF发作。13名运动员（27%）在运动期间发生AF，其中2人在高强度运动期间发生AF。与运动无关（运动后>3小时，0.61 [95% CI，0.26-1.13]）相比，运动期间（0.34每24小时 [95% CI，0.13-0.65]）或运动后（0.37 [95% CI，0.10-0.71]）的AF事件率并未更高。没有运动相关室性心动过速的发作。

title: Echocardiographic Left Atrial Volumetric-mechanical Coupling Index for Prediction of Atrial Fibrillation after STEMI.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) commonly complicates ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). Conventional echocardiographic measures may incompletely capture left atrial remodeling. The left atrial volumetric-mechanical coupling index (LACI-vm), integrating left atrial volume index (LAVI) and mitral annular a' velocity, emerges as a novel predictor of cardiovascular outcomes. This study evaluated the association between LACI-vm measured during index hospitalization and incident AF after STEMI and its incremental predictive value beyond clinical and echocardiographic variables.

METHODS: Consecutive STEMI patients undergoing primary coronary angiography from 2017-2023 were retrospectively analyzed. LACI-vm was calculated as LAVI/a'. Patients with prior AF/flutter, non-sinus rhythm during echocardiography, or significant structural heart disease were excluded. Multivariable Cox regression, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, and net reclassification improvement (NRI) were performed.

RESULTS: Among 469 patients (64.5 ± 12.5 years, 24.9% female), median LACI-vm was 3.4 (IQR 2.6-4.9). During a median 56-month follow-up (2,193 person-years), 66 patients (14.1%) developed AF, with an incidence rate of 30.1 per 1,000 person-years. AF incidence was higher with LACI-vm >3.4 than ≤3.4 (23.9% vs. 4.3%, 58.0 vs. 8.1 per 1,000 person-years). LACI-vm independently predicted AF (HR 2.73, 95% CI 1.33-5.64, p=0.006). ROC analysis showed an AUC of 0.857; a cutoff of 4.27 yielded 81% sensitivity and 91% specificity. LACI-vm was not independently associated with mortality. NRI demonstrated improved AF prediction (0.170-0.175, all p<0.001).

CONCLUSIONS: LACI-vm independently predicts post-STEMI AF and may identify patients who could benefit from intensified rhythm monitoring after discharge.

AI.tldr: 在STEMI患者中，基于LAVI与a'速度计算的新指标LACI-vm可独立预测出院后新发房颤，AUC达0.857，并改善风险分层。
AI.motivation: 房颤是STEMI常见并发症，传统超声指标对左房重构评估不全面。LACI-vm整合左房容积指数与二尖瓣环a'速度，可能更全面反映左房功能-结构耦联，但其对STEMI后新发房颤的预测价值及增量价值尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性分析2017-2023年连续接受直接冠脉造影的STEMI患者，排除既往房颤/房扑、超声时非窦性心律或显著结构性心脏病者。计算LACI-vm=LAVI/a'。采用多因素Cox回归、ROC曲线及净重分类改善（NRI）评估其预测价值。
AI.result: 共纳入469例（年龄64.5±12.5岁，女性24.9%），LACI-vm中位数3.4（IQR 2.6-4.9）。中位随访56个月（2193人年），66例（14.1%）发生房颤，发生率30.1/1000人年。LACI-vm>3.4者房颤发生率显著高于≤3.4者（23.9% vs 4.3%，58.0 vs 8.1/1000人年）。LACI-vm独立预测房颤（HR 2.73，95%CI 1.33-5.64，p=0.006）。ROC分析AUC为0.857，切点4.27时敏感度81%、特异度91%。LACI-vm与死亡率无独立关联。NRI显示房颤预测改善（0.170-0.175，均p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: LACI-vm可独立预测STEMI后新发房颤，并改善临床及超声变量的预测效能，有助于识别出院后需强化心律监测的高危患者。但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，切点值需外部验证，且未报告对死亡率的影响。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）常并发于ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）。常规超声心动图指标可能无法完全反映左心房重构。左心房容积-机械耦联指数（LACI-vm）整合了左心房容积指数（LAVI）与二尖瓣环a'速度，已成为心血管结局的新型预测指标。本研究评估了住院期间测量的LACI-vm与STEMI后新发AF之间的关联，以及其在临床和超声心动图变量之外的增量预测价值。

方法：回顾性分析2017-2023年连续接受直接冠状动脉造影的STEMI患者。LACI-vm按LAVI/a'计算。排除既往有AF/心房扑动、超声心动图检查时非窦性心律或存在显著结构性心脏病的患者。进行了多变量Cox回归、受试者工作特征（ROC）分析及净重分类改善（NRI）。

结果：在469例患者中（64.5 ± 12.5岁，24.9%为女性），LACI-vm中位数为3.4（IQR 2.6-4.9）。在中位56个月随访期间（2,193人年），66例患者（14.1%）发生AF，发病率为每1,000人年30.1例。LACI-vm >3.4者的AF发生率高于≤3.4者（23.9% vs. 4.3%，每1,000人年58.0 vs. 8.1例）。LACI-vm可独立预测AF（HR 2.73，95% CI 1.33-5.64，p=0.006）。ROC分析显示AUC为0.857；截断值4.27的敏感性为81%，特异性为91%。LACI-vm与死亡率无独立关联。NRI显示AF预测得到改善（0.170-0.175，所有p<0.001）。

结论：LACI-vm可独立预测STEMI后AF，并可能识别出院外可从强化心律监测中获益的患者。

title: Thromboembolic and Mortality Risk in Patients with Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft—The TRIP-AF Study
summary: Background/Objectives: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is a common complication of coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) and may recur during cardiac rehabilitation (CR); its long-term prognostic value remains unclear. We evaluated the impact of POAF on a composite endpoint of all-cause mortality and non-fatal stroke after isolated CABG and assessed POAF duration and timing, AF recurrence, and other predictors of adverse outcomes. Methods: This multicentre retrospective study enrolled 1139 patients who underwent CR after isolated CABG between 2011 and 2015 across 17 Italian centres. Clinical and outcome data were obtained from medical records and structured interviews; median follow-up was 5.78 years. Results: POAF occurred in 34.3% of patients and was associated with a higher incidence of the primary composite endpoint of all-cause mortality and non-fatal stroke in univariate analysis (15.4% vs. 10.0%, p = 0.008), particularly when lasting ≥48 h or occurring during both surgery and rehabilitation. However, in multivariate analysis POAF was not an independent predictor; instead, CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥3, reduced left ventricular ejection fraction, elevated urea, history of heart failure, and AF recurrence during follow-up predicted adverse outcomes. Conclusions: POAF reflects early vulnerability but does not independently predict long-term mortality or stroke. Conversely, AF recurrence and CHA2DS2-VASc score retain strong prognostic value, underscoring the need for long-term rhythm monitoring and individualised risk assessment post-CABG.

AI.tldr: 孤立CABG术后约1/3患者发生术后房颤，其与全因死亡和非致死性卒中的复合终点相关，但多因素校正后并非独立预测因子，房颤复发和CHA2DS2-VASc评分才是长期预后的关键。
AI.motivation: 术后房颤（POAF）是冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）后的常见并发症，且可能在心脏康复（CR）期间复发，但其长期预后价值尚不明确。本研究旨在评估POAF对孤立CABG术后全因死亡与非致死性卒中复合终点的影响，并分析POAF持续时间与发生时机、房颤复发及其他不良结局预测因素。
AI.method: 多中心回顾性研究，纳入2011至2015年间意大利17个中心接受孤立CABG后进入心脏康复的1139例患者。临床与结局数据来自病历和结构化访谈，中位随访5.78年。主要终点为全因死亡与非致死性卒中的复合终点；分析POAF持续时间、发生时机（术中及/或康复期间）、房颤复发及其他预测因素，采用单因素和多因素分析。
AI.result: POAF发生率为34.3%。单因素分析中，POAF与主要复合终点发生率升高相关（15.4% vs 10.0%，p=0.008），尤其在POAF持续≥48小时或于手术期和康复期均发生时更为明显。但多因素分析显示POAF并非独立预测因子；独立预测因素为CHA2DS2-VASc评分≥3、左心室射血分数降低、尿素升高、心力衰竭病史及随访期间房颤复发。
AI.conclusion: POAF反映早期易损状态，但不独立预测长期死亡或卒中；房颤复发与CHA2DS2-VASc评分仍具强预后价值，提示CABG术后需长期节律监测和个体化风险评估。本研究为回顾性设计，POAF监测方式及复发定义等细节摘要未报告，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景/目的：术后心房颤动（POAF）是冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）的常见并发症，并可能在心脏康复（CR）期间复发；其长期预后价值尚不明确。我们评估了POAF对孤立性CABG术后全因死亡和非致死性卒中复合终点的影响，并评估了POAF的持续时间和发生时机、AF复发以及其他不良结局的预测因素。

方法：这项多中心回顾性研究纳入了2011年至2015年间在意大利17个中心接受孤立性CABG后行CR的1139例患者。临床和结局数据来自医疗记录和结构化访谈；中位随访时间为5.78年。

结果：34.3%的患者发生POAF，在单变量分析中，POAF与全因死亡和非致死性卒中主要复合终点的发生率较高相关（15.4% vs. 10.0%，p = 0.008），尤其是当POAF持续≥48小时或在手术和康复期间均发生时。然而，在多变量分析中，POAF并非独立预测因素；相反，CHA2DS2-VASc评分≥3、左心室射血分数降低、尿素升高、心力衰竭病史以及随访期间AF复发可预测不良结局。

title: Perceived Social Support in Atrial Fibrillation Care: Implications for Nurse-Led Education and Follow-Up.
summary:
AIM: To describe the level, content and sources of perceived social support among adults with atrial fibrillation, and to identify clinical, lifestyle and care pathway factors associated with perceived support.

DESIGN: A cross-sectional survey design.

METHODS: Data were collected through an online survey disseminated across Finland in 2025 via the Finnish Heart Association's website and social media channels among adults with self-reported atrial fibrillation. Perceived social support was measured using the Social Support for Patients with Atrial Fibrillation Instrument, which assesses informational, emotional, and functional support. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics and separate univariate General Linear Model analyses.

RESULTS: Participants reported low-to-moderate informational, emotional, and functional support. Patient education was received primarily from physicians, whereas nurse-delivered education was uncommon, and more than half of participants reported no scheduled follow-up visits. Informational support was strongest for disease consequences and medication information, while support related to treatment options and follow-up monitoring was lower. Emotional support was mainly received from family and friends, while functional support was stronger for self-monitoring than for medication management and structured follow-up. Ablation treatment was consistently associated with lower perceived support across all domains, whereas scheduled follow-up visits were associated with higher emotional support.

CONCLUSIONS: Perceived social support among adults with atrial fibrillation was uneven and embedded in the formal care pathway. Support gaps were evident in follow-up, nurse-delivered education, medication management, and practical atrial fibrillation-specific self-management.

IMPLICATIONS FOR THE PROFESSION AND/OR PATIENT CARE: Cardiovascular nurses can strengthen atrial fibrillation care by providing structured patient education, emotional support, practical self-management support, and follow-up, particularly after ablation and during long-term care.

IMPACT: This study addresses the limited evidence on perceived social support among adults with atrial fibrillation. The findings suggest that support is unevenly integrated into atrial fibrillation care pathways and that nurse-led education and structured follow-up remain underused. The findings identify opportunities to strengthen atrial fibrillation care.

REPORTING METHOD: The study was reported according to the STROBE guideline for cross-sectional studies.

PATIENT OR PUBLIC CONTRIBUTION: No Patient or Public Contribution.

AI.tldr: 芬兰房颤患者感知社会支持总体偏低且不均衡，消融治疗与支持较低相关，而计划随访与较高情感支持相关。
AI.motivation: 成人房颤患者感知社会支持的证据有限，且既往研究未充分描述其水平、内容、来源及与临床和照护路径因素的关联，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 横断面调查研究，2025年通过芬兰心脏协会网站和社交媒体在芬兰全国范围招募自报房颤的成人患者，使用房颤患者社会支持量表测量信息、情感和功能性支持，采用描述性统计和单因素一般线性模型分析临床、生活方式及照护路径因素与感知支持的关联。
AI.result: 患者报告的信息、情感和功能性支持均为低至中等水平；患者教育主要来自医生，护士主导的教育不常见，超过半数无计划随访；信息支持在疾病后果和药物信息方面最强，治疗选择和随访监测方面较低；情感支持主要来自家人和朋友，功能性支持在自我监测方面强于药物管理和结构化随访；消融治疗与所有领域感知支持较低一致相关，而计划随访与较高情感支持相关。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI和P值。
AI.conclusion: 房颤患者感知社会支持不均衡且嵌入正式照护路径，在随访、护士主导教育、药物管理和房颤特异性自我管理方面存在支持缺口；心血管护士可通过结构化患者教育、情感支持、实用自我管理支持和随访来加强房颤照护，尤其消融后和长期照护中；本研究为横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，且样本为自报房颤的在线调查人群，存在选择偏倚可能。

summary_zh:
目的：描述心房颤动成人患者感知社会支持的水平、内容和来源，并识别与感知支持相关的临床、生活方式和护理路径因素。

设计：横断面调查设计。

方法：数据通过2025年在芬兰全国范围内通过芬兰心脏协会网站和社交媒体渠道传播的在线调查收集，对象为自我报告心房颤动的成人。感知社会支持使用心房颤动患者社会支持量表测量，该量表评估信息性、情感性和功能性支持。数据分析采用描述性统计和单独的單变量一般线性模型分析。

结果：参与者报告的信息性、情感性和功能性支持为低至中等水平。患者教育主要来自医生，而护士提供的教育不常见，超过一半的参与者报告没有预定的随访就诊。信息性支持在疾病后果和药物信息方面最强，而关于治疗选择和随访监测的支持较低。情感支持主要来自家人和朋友，而功能性支持在自我监测方面强于药物管理和结构化随访。消融治疗在所有领域均一致与较低的感知支持相关，而预定随访就诊与较高的情感支持相关。

结论：心房颤动成人患者的感知社会支持不均衡，并嵌入在正式护理路径中。在随访、护士提供的教育、药物管理和心房颤动特异性自我管理的实际支持方面存在明显支持缺口。

对专业和/或患者护理的启示：心血管护士可以通过提供结构化患者教育、情感支持、实际自我管理支持和随访来加强心房颤动护理，特别是在消融后和长期护理期间。

影响：本研究针对心房颤动成人患者感知社会支持证据有限的问题。研究结果表明支持在心房颤动护理路径中整合不均衡，护士主导的教育和结构化随访仍未充分利用。研究结果识别了加强心房颤动护理的机会。

报告方法：本研究按照STROBE横断面研究指南进行报告。

title: Identifying the electrically unstable NSTEMI patient: Comparative performance of four scores for short-term risk stratification of major cardiac arrhythmias
summary: Background Major cardiac arrhythmias after NSTEMI are associated with increased mortality and adverse clinical outcomes. However, evidence comparing the ability of established acute coronary syndrome risk scores to predict in-hospital arrhythmic events remains limited.Methods We conducted a retrospective cohort study of consecutive NSTEMI patients who underwent coronary angiography at Taipei Medical University Hospital between January 2017 and August 2022. Major cardiac arrhythmias were defined as ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, new-onset atrial fibrillation, and high-degree atrioventricular block occurring during hospitalization. Clinical characteristics, laboratory findings, electrocardiographic features, and angiographic data were analyzed. The discriminatory performance of TIMI, HEART, GRACE 2.0, T-MACS, and an integrated multivariable model was evaluated using ROC analysis.Results A total of 485 patients were included, among whom 55 (11.3%) developed major cardiac arrhythmias during hospitalization. Patients with arrhythmias had significantly higher rates of prior heart failure, AKI, and RBBB. Multivariable logistic regression identified heart failure (OR 3.663, p < 0.001), RBBB (OR 2.611, p = 0.030), AKI (OR 2.102, p = 0.045), and higher serum sodium levels (OR 1.079, p = 0.012) as independent predictors of arrhythmic events. The integrated prediction model demonstrated higher observed discrimination for major cardiac arrhythmias (AUC 0.733, p < 0.001) compared with conventional ACS scoring systems. In contrast, the GRACE 2.0 score showed the most consistent performance for predicting in-hospital mortality.Conclusion In NSTEMI patients, an exploratory model incorporating heart failure, AKI, RBBB, and serum sodium showed discriminatory ability for major cardiac arrhythmias. Meanwhile, the GRACE 2.0 score remained the most reliable tool for mortality prediction, supporting its continued role in global prognostic assessment of NSTEMI patients.

AI.tldr: 在485例NSTEMI患者中，11.3%发生主要心律失常，整合心衰、AKI、RBBB和血钠的模型预测心律失常的AUC为0.733，优于传统ACS评分，而GRACE 2.0对院内死亡预测最稳定。
AI.motivation: NSTEMI后主要心律失常与死亡率增加及不良临床结局相关，但现有急性冠脉综合征风险评分预测院内心律失常事件的能力比较证据有限，临床缺乏可靠的心律失常风险分层工具。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2017年1月至2022年8月在台北医学大学医院接受冠状动脉造影的连续NSTEMI患者485例。主要心律失常定义为住院期间发生的室性心动过速、心室颤动、新发心房颤动和高度房室传导阻滞。分析临床特征、实验室检查、心电图和血管造影数据，采用ROC分析评估TIMI、HEART、GRACE 2.0、T-MACS及整合多变量模型的判别性能。
AI.result: 55例（11.3%）发生主要心律失常。心律失常组既往心衰、急性肾损伤（AKI）和右束支传导阻滞（RBBB）比例显著更高。多变量logistic回归确定心衰（OR 3.663，p<0.001）、RBBB（OR 2.611，p=0.030）、AKI（OR 2.102，p=0.045）和较高血钠水平（OR 1.079，p=0.012）为心律失常事件的独立预测因素。整合预测模型对主要心律失常的判别能力（AUC 0.733，p<0.001）高于传统ACS评分系统；GRACE 2.0评分对院内死亡预测表现最一致。
AI.conclusion: 在NSTEMI患者中，整合心衰、AKI、RBBB和血钠的探索性模型对主要心律失常具有判别能力，而GRACE 2.0仍是死亡预测最可靠的工具，支持其继续用于NSTEMI患者的整体预后评估。该模型为探索性，需外部验证；摘要未报告各评分AUC的具体数值及置信区间。

背景：NSTEMI 后发生重大心脏心律失常与死亡率增加及不良临床结局相关。然而，比较现有急性冠脉综合征风险评分预测院内心律失常事件能力的证据仍然有限。

方法：我们开展了一项回顾性队列研究，纳入 2017 年 1 月至 2022 年 8 月期间在台北医学大学附设医院接受冠状动脉造影的连续 NSTEMI 患者。重大心脏心律失常定义为住院期间发生的室性心动过速、心室颤动、新发心房颤动和高度房室传导阻滞。分析了临床特征、实验室检查结果、心电图特征和血管造影数据。使用 ROC 分析评估 TIMI、HEART、GRACE 2.0、T-MACS 及一个整合多变量模型的判别性能。

结果：共纳入 485 例患者，其中 55 例（11.3%）在住院期间发生重大心脏心律失常。发生心律失常的患者既往心力衰竭、AKI 和 RBBB 的发生率显著更高。多变量 logistic 回归确定心力衰竭（OR 3.663，p < 0.001）、RBBB（OR 2.611，p = 0.030）、AKI（OR 2.102，p = 0.045）和较高的血清钠水平（OR 1.079，p = 0.012）为心律失常事件的独立预测因素。与传统 ACS 评分系统相比，整合预测模型对重大心脏心律失常表现出更高的观察判别能力（AUC 0.733，p < 0.001）。相比之下，GRACE 2.0 评分在预测院内死亡率方面表现出最一致的性能。

结论：在 NSTEMI 患者中，一个纳入心力衰竭、AKI、RBBB 和血清钠的探索性模型对重大心脏心律失常显示出判别能力。同时，GRACE 2.0 评分仍然是死亡率预测最可靠的工具，支持其继续在全球 NSTEMI 患者预后评估中发挥作用。

title: First Latin American retrospective registry of cardiac ablation in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients. A LAHRS registry.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablation has been proven as an effective and safe therapy for tachyarrhythmias in pediatric and congenital heart disease (CHD) patients. Although there are international registries on the use of catheter ablation in these populations, none of them include Latin American countries.

OBJECTIVES: To assess the clinical characteristics of pediatric and congenital heart disease patients undergoing catheter ablation procedures. Data obtained includes types of arrhythmias, techniques, success, complications and recurrence rates.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: A descriptive and analytical retrospective observational study was performed. A closed coded online form available for 6 months was used. All electrophysiologists who practice pediatric electrophysiology in Latin America and were identified in a previous LAHSR's survey were invited to participate through Latin American Heart Rhythm Society (LAHRS) electronic media ( https://lahrs.org/ ). Participation was not mandatory, it was not encouraged by any economic or material goods, and an informed consent for the use of the data was required. Consecutive electrophysiological catheter procedures were included in children under 18 years of age or patients with CHD, regardless age, between 2017 and 2021.

RESULTS: Twenty physicians from 8 Latin American countries participated. A total of 1778 procedures were reported, 53% were male, mean age was 12.4 ± 5.1 years and 8.5% had congenital heart disease. An ablation was attempted in 87% of the patients, using a non-irrigated tip radiofrequency catheter in 68% of them, and a 3-D mapping system in 29%. Radiofrequency was the most commonly used energy source in 98% of the cases. The most frequent substrates were accessory pathways in 69.5% (61% were manifest), followed by AV nodal reentry in 16.5% and ectopic atrial tachycardia in 4%. Additionally, there were 3.8% atrial flutter, 3.8% ventricular tachycardias, 1.2% premature ventricular contractions. Ablation was considered acutely successful in 93% of the cases. Mean total procedural time was 92.1 ± 36.8 min and mean total fluoroscopy time was 16.3 ± 9.4 min. Complication rate was 1.8% and included complete AV block in 3 patients (0.2%). No deaths were reported. The recurrence rate was 8.5%.

CONCLUSIONS: In this first exclusively pediatric and congenital heart disease retrospective registry of catheter ablation in Latin America, a high rate of success and low incidence of complications was observed. This is in concordance with previously reported registries from other latitudes, proving that ablation is an effective and safe therapy in this group of patients.

AI.tldr: 拉丁美洲首个儿童及先天性心脏病患者导管消融回顾性注册研究显示，1778例手术急性成功率93%，并发症率1.8%，复发率8.5%，证实消融在该人群安全有效。
AI.motivation: 导管消融已被证明是儿童及先天性心脏病（CHD）患者快速性心律失常的有效安全疗法，国际上已有相关注册研究，但尚无涵盖拉丁美洲国家的数据，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 描述性及分析性回顾性观察研究，通过LAHRS电子媒体邀请拉丁美洲从事儿童电生理的医师参与，使用封闭编码在线表单收集2017-2021年连续电生理导管手术数据，纳入<18岁儿童或任何年龄CHD患者，评估心律失常类型、技术、成功率、并发症及复发率。
AI.result: 共20名医师来自8个拉美国家，报告1778例手术，男性53%，平均年龄12.4±5.1岁，CHD占8.5%。87%尝试消融，68%使用非冷盐水灌注射频导管，29%使用三维标测系统，98%使用射频能量。最常见基质为旁路（69.5%，其中61%显性），其次为AVNRT（16.5%）、房速（4%）、房扑（3.8%）、室速（3.8%）、室早（1.2%）。急性成功93%，平均手术时间92.1±36.8 min，透视时间16.3±9.4 min。并发症率1.8%，包括完全性房室阻滞3例（0.2%），无死亡。复发率8.5%。
AI.conclusion: 拉丁美洲首个儿童及CHD导管消融注册研究显示高成功率、低并发症率，与其他地区注册研究一致，证明消融在该人群有效安全；但研究为回顾性、参与非强制，存在选择偏倚，需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：导管消融已被证明是治疗儿童及先天性心脏病（CHD）患者快速性心律失常的有效且安全的方法。尽管已有关于这些人群导管消融使用的国际注册研究，但其中均未纳入拉丁美洲国家。

目的：评估接受导管消融手术的儿童及先天性心脏病患者的临床特征。所获数据包括心律失常类型、技术、成功率、并发症及复发率。

材料与方法：进行了一项描述性和分析性回顾性观察研究。使用了一个开放6个月的封闭编码在线表格。所有在拉丁美洲从事儿童电生理工作并在先前LAHSR调查中被识别的电生理学家，通过拉丁美洲心律学会（LAHRS）电子媒体（https://lahrs.org/）受邀参与。参与非强制，未受任何经济或物质奖励鼓励，且需知情同意使用数据。连续纳入2017年至2021年间18岁以下儿童或任何年龄的CHD患者接受的电生理导管手术。

结果：来自8个拉丁美洲国家的20名医生参与。共报告1778例手术，53%为男性，平均年龄12.4 ± 5.1岁，8.5%患有先天性心脏病。87%的患者尝试了消融，其中68%使用非灌注射频消融导管，29%使用三维标测系统。射频是98%病例中最常用的能量源。最常见基质为旁路，占69.5%（61%为显性），其次为房室结折返，占16.5%，异位房性心动过速占4%。此外，心房扑动占3.8%，室性心动过速占3.8%，室性早搏占1.2%。93%的病例消融被认为急性成功。平均总手术时间为92.1 ± 36.8分钟，平均总透视时间为16.3 ± 9.4分钟。并发症率为1.8%，包括3例患者（0.2%）完全性房室传导阻滞。未报告死亡。复发率为8.5%。

结论：在这项首个专门针对拉丁美洲儿童及先天性心脏病患者导管消融的回顾性注册研究中，观察到高成功率和低并发症发生率。这与先前来自其他地区的注册研究报告一致，证明消融在该组患者中是一种有效且安全的治疗方法。

title: Efficacy and Safety of Novel Oral Anticoagulants in Elderly Patients with Non-Valvular Atrial Fibrillation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
summary: Adults aged 80 years or older with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF) often have competing thromboembolic and bleeding risks, renal impairment, frailty, and dose-selection challenges. This single-center retrospective observational cohort included 202 adults aged 80 years or older who received warfarin (n = 56), edoxaban 60 mg once daily (n = 38), edoxaban 30 mg once daily (n = 41), rivaroxaban 15 mg once daily (n = 35), or rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily (n = 32). Six-month embolic events, International Society on Thrombosis and Hemostasis (ISTH) bleeding categories, other adverse reactions, official-label dose concordance, dynamic risk scores, and serial laboratory measurements were evaluated. Exploratory generalized overlap weighting addressed measured treatment-selection differences. Embolic events occurred in 8 patients and ISTH minor bleeding in 21; neither outcome differed significantly among groups (exact p = 0.846 and p = 0.199, respectively). No ISTH major or clinically relevant non-major bleeding occurred. Other adverse reactions differed overall (p = 0.014), but pairwise estimates were imprecise. Of 146 direct oral anticoagulant recipients, 72 (49.3%) received a baseline dose concordant with the prespecified official-label framework, 72 (49.3%) received a lower-than-label dose, and 2 (1.4%) received a higher-than-label dose. Low event counts and marked treatment-selection imbalance prevented conclusions of equivalence, superiority, or greater safety. The findings require confirmation in larger, prospectively defined cohorts with longer follow-up, predefined label-dose criteria, and stronger control of confounding.

AI.tldr: 在80岁及以上非瓣膜性房颤患者中，华法林与四种低剂量DOAC方案的6个月栓塞及ISTH出血事件均无显著差异，但近半数DOAC用药剂量低于说明书推荐。
AI.motivation: 80岁及以上非瓣膜性房颤患者同时面临血栓栓塞与出血风险、肾功能不全、衰弱及抗凝剂量选择困难，而该人群在随机试验中代表性不足，不同DOAC及剂量方案在这一高龄人群中的疗效与安全性证据有限。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性观察性队列，纳入202例80岁及以上非瓣膜性房颤患者，分为华法林组（n=56）、依度沙班60 mg每日一次组（n=38）、依度沙班30 mg每日一次组（n=41）、利伐沙班15 mg每日一次组（n=35）、利伐沙班10 mg每日一次组（n=32）。评估6个月栓塞事件、ISTH出血分级、其他不良反应、说明书剂量一致性、动态风险评分及系列实验室指标；采用探索性广义重叠加权校正已测量的治疗选择差异。
AI.result: 6个月内共8例发生栓塞事件、21例发生ISTH轻微出血，各组间均无显著差异（精确P分别为0.846和0.199）；未发生ISTH大出血或临床相关非大出血。其他不良反应总体存在组间差异（P=0.014），但两两比较估计不精确。146例DOAC使用者中，72例（49.3%）基线剂量符合预设说明书框架，72例（49.3%）低于说明书剂量，2例（1.4%）高于说明书剂量。事件数少且治疗选择失衡明显，无法得出等效、优效或更安全的结论。
AI.conclusion: 该高龄非瓣膜性房颤队列中，华法林与依度沙班、利伐沙班不同剂量方案在6个月栓塞和出血事件上未见显著差异，但近半数DOAC患者剂量低于说明书推荐，提示高龄人群剂量选择存在偏差。受限于样本量小、事件数少和回顾性设计，结果不能作为等效性或安全性结论，需更大规模、前瞻性、随访更长且预设剂量标准并充分控制混杂的队列验证。

summary_zh: 80岁及以上患有非瓣膜性心房颤动（NVAF）的成人常同时面临血栓栓塞与出血风险、肾功能损害、衰弱以及剂量选择难题。这项单中心回顾性观察性队列研究纳入了202名80岁及以上的成人，他们分别接受华法林（n = 56）、依度沙班60 mg每日一次（n = 38）、依度沙班30 mg每日一次（n = 41）、利伐沙班15 mg每日一次（n = 35）或利伐沙班10 mg每日一次（n = 32）治疗。评估了6个月时的栓塞事件、国际血栓与止血学会（ISTH）出血分类、其他不良反应、与官方标签剂量的符合性、动态风险评分以及系列实验室检测指标。探索性广义重叠加权用于处理已测量的治疗选择差异。8例患者发生栓塞事件，21例发生ISTH轻微出血；两种结局在各组间均无显著差异（精确p值分别为0.846和0.199）。未发生ISTH大出血或临床相关非大出血。其他不良反应总体存在差异（p = 0.014），但两两比较的估计值不精确。在146例直接口服抗凝药接受者中，72例（49.3%）的基线剂量与预设的官方标签框架相符，72例（49.3%）接受了低于标签的剂量，2例（1.4%）接受了高于标签的剂量。事件数少和明显的治疗选择失衡妨碍了得出等效性、优效性或更高安全性的结论。这些发现需要在更大规模、前瞻性定义的队列中加以证实，并需更长的随访时间、预先定义的标签剂量标准以及更强地控制混杂因素。

title: Effects of Rhythm Control versus Rate Control on Atrial Fibrillation and Frailty Development in Older Patients: Protocol for the Cardioversion of Atrial Fibrillation and Frailty in the Elderly (CAFFE) Study, an Observational, Prospective Cohort Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF), highly prevalent in older individuals, is associated with frailty and disability. AF therapy is based on rhythm control (RhythmC) to restore sinus rhythm or rate control (RateC) to lower the heart rate. Published guidelines do not indicate a preference for one over the other for older people.

OBJECTIVE: This study aims to evaluate whether RhythmC is more effective than RateC in hindering the progression of frailty and disability.

METHODS: The Cardioversion of Atrial Fibrillation and Frailty in the Elderly (CAFFE) study is a prospective, multicenter, observational cohort study that includes 4 groups of patients: (1) adults age 75 years or older undergoing RhythmC treatment; (2) adults aged 65 to 74 years undergoing RhythmC treatment; (3) adults 65 years or older undergoing RateC treatment; and (4) adults 65 years or older without overt chronic conditions as the control group (n=40 in each group). At baseline, all participants will undergo a Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment (CGA) and analyses of inflammation and metabolomics. At home, a device will evaluate each participant's heart rhythm, activity profile, and sleep. After 1 month, the CGA will be repeated.

RESULTS: The CAFFE study was funded as a Research Project of National Interest by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (October 2023). Ethical committee final approval was given in June 2024. In October 2025, the coordinating center had enrolled 31 of 40 patients with AF (mean age 78, SD 9 years; 8 [25.8%] women; mean CHA2DS2-VA score 4.2, SD 1.2; 13 [43.3%] robust participants). All centers are now completing the enrollment (103/160 participants), and the analysis of inflammatory mediators has started. The results are expected to be published in summer 2027.

CONCLUSIONS: The CAFFE study will evaluate the effectiveness of AF management strategies in older patients. If RhythmC can slow the progression of frailty and disability, specific clinical trials should more definitively address this knowledge gap.

AI.tldr: CAFFE研究方案旨在评估节律控制是否比心率控制更能延缓老年房颤患者衰弱与失能的进展，目前仍在入组中，结果预计2027年发布。
AI.motivation: 房颤在老年人群中高发，与衰弱和失能相关。现有指南未对老年患者优先选择节律控制还是心率控制给出推荐，缺乏比较两者对衰弱进展影响的证据。
AI.method: CAFFE研究为前瞻性、多中心、观察性队列研究，计划纳入4组各40例患者：≥75岁接受节律控制组、65-74岁接受节律控制组、≥65岁接受心率控制组、≥65岁无明确慢性病的对照组。基线进行综合老年评估（CGA）及炎症和代谢组学分析，居家设备监测心律、活动与睡眠，1个月后重复CGA。主要终点为衰弱和失能进展，摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 研究已获意大利大学与研究部资助（2023年10月）及伦理批准（2024年6月）。截至2025年10月，协调中心已入组31/40例房颤患者（平均年龄78岁，SD 9；女性8例[25.8%]；平均CHA2DS2-VA评分4.2，SD 1.2；13例[43.3%]为健壮者），全部中心入组103/160例，炎症介质分析已启动。主要终点结果摘要未报告，预计2027年夏季发表。
AI.conclusion: CAFFE研究将评估老年房颤患者节律控制与心率控制策略对衰弱和失能进展的影响。若节律控制可延缓衰弱进展，将为后续针对性临床试验提供依据，并可能影响老年房颤的电生理管理决策。目前结果尚未公布，存在观察性设计等局限性。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）在老年人中非常普遍，与衰弱和失能相关。AF的治疗基于节律控制（RhythmC）以恢复窦性心律或心率控制（RateC）以降低心率。已发表的指南并未表明在老年人中优先选择其中一种。

目的：本研究旨在评估RhythmC是否比RateC更有效地阻止衰弱和失能的进展。

方法：心房颤动复律与老年人衰弱（CAFFE）研究是一项前瞻性、多中心、观察性队列研究，包括4组患者：（1）75岁及以上接受RhythmC治疗的成人；（2）65至74岁接受RhythmC治疗的成人；（3）65岁及以上接受RateC治疗的成人；（4）65岁及以上无明确慢性疾病的成人作为对照组（每组n=40）。在基线时，所有参与者将接受综合老年评估（CGA）以及炎症和代谢组学分析。在家中，设备将评估每位参与者的心律、活动情况和睡眠。1个月后，将重复CGA。

结果：CAFFE研究被意大利大学与研究部资助为国家利益研究项目（2023年10月）。伦理委员会最终批准于2024年6月给出。2025年10月，协调中心已入组40例AF患者中的31例（平均年龄78岁，SD 9岁；8例[25.8%]女性；平均CHA2DS2-VA评分4.2，SD 1.2；13例[43.3%]健壮参与者）。所有中心目前正在完成入组（103/160名参与者），炎症介质分析已经开始。结果预计将于2027年夏季发表。

结论：CAFFE研究将评估AF管理策略在老年患者中的有效性。如果RhythmC能够减缓衰弱和失能的进展，则应开展特定临床试验以更明确地解决这一知识空白。

title: Evaluation of Clinical SYNTAX Score in Predicting New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation and Long-Term Prognosis in Patients Hospitalized with Non-ST Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
summary: New-onset atrial fibrillation (NOAF) is a frequent complication among patients with non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI) and is associated with adverse outcomes, making early identification of predictors essential for risk stratification and management. This retrospective cohort study evaluated the prognostic value of the Clinical SYNTAX Score (CSS) compared with the anatomical SYNTAX Score (SS), GRACE, and CHA2DS2-VASc scores in predicting in-hospital NOAF and long-term outcomes among 979 NSTEMI patients undergoing coronary angiography. Predictors of NOAF, all-cause mortality, and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE: death, myocardial infarction, stroke) were identified using logistic and Cox regression models, with receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis used to compare the discriminative power of CSS against SS, GRACE, and CHA2DS2-VASc over a median follow-up of 86 months (IQR: 0.1–144). NOAF developed in 80 patients (8.2%), with age, female gender, left atrial diameter, left ventricular diastolic dysfunction, and CSS (p=0.014) identified as independent predictors. CSS demonstrated superior discriminative ability (AUC: 0.724; 95% CI: 0.673–0.775) compared with SS (AUC: 0.644; 95% CI: 0.588–0.699), and a CSS threshold ≥17.77 predicted NOAF with 75% sensitivity and 65% specificity. In Cox regression analysis, in-hospital NOAF, age, hypertension, reduced ejection fraction (<60%), and CSS independently predicted long-term all-cause mortality, while NOAF, EF<60%, age, early AF recurrence, hypertension, and CSS independently predicted MACE; SS was not a significant predictor in either model. These findings indicate that CSS outperforms SS in predicting in-hospital NOAF and long-term outcomes in NSTEMI patients, offering a practical and comprehensive tool for early rhythm monitoring and risk-guided management.

title: Transient changes in P-wave terminal force after electrical cardioversion of persistent atrial fibrillation
summary: BACKGROUND: P-wave terminal force in lead V1 (PWTFV1) reflects left atrial remodeling and is associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) outcomes, but its time course after electrical cardioversion of persistent AF is unclear. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 108 patients with persistent AF after successful electrical cardioversion, with 12‑lead electrocardiograms at 30 min, 1 month, and 3 months. Terminal P-wave duration (PNTV1) and amplitude (PNAV1) in lead V1 were measured and PWTFV1 calculated as their product; changes are expressed in absolute magnitude. Correlations with left atrial diameter and categorical classification (abnormal if magnitude ≥4000 ms·μV) were assessed. RESULTS: PNTV1 increased at 1 month versus 30 min (60 ± 25 vs 58 ± 19 ms; P = 0.018) and returned to baseline at 3 months (57 ± 19 ms; P = 0.83; Friedman P = 0.031). PNAV1 was unchanged (P = 0.37). PWTFV1 increased transiently in magnitude at 1 month (-4294 ± 2545 vs -4079 ± 2138 ms·μV; P = 0.022) and normalized at 3 months (-4039 ± 2060 ms·μV; P = 0.64). PWTFV1 did not correlate with left atrial diameter (all |ρ| ≈ 0.05, P ≥ 0.61), and categorical classification was unchanged (57/108 abnormal throughout; no patient reclassified). CONCLUSION: PWTFV1 shows transient, duration-driven variability after cardioversion, peaking at 1 month. The change is small, does not alter categorical classification, and is not mirrored by left atrial size, consistent with ongoing atrial recovery rather than stable remodeling. Timing of assessment matters when PWTFV1 is interpreted as a continuous measure.

AI.tldr: 持续性房颤电复律后，P波终末电势在1个月时短暂增大，3个月恢复，不改变分类，与左房大小无关。
AI.motivation: P波终末电势（PWTFV1）反映左房重构并与房颤结局相关，但持续性房颤电复律后其时间变化过程尚不明确，临床解读时机缺乏依据。
AI.method: 回顾性分析108例持续性房颤成功电复律患者，于复律后30分钟、1个月、3个月记录12导联心电图，测量V1导联终末P波时限（PNTV1）和振幅（PNAV1），计算PWTFV1（乘积），以绝对值表示变化；评估与左房直径的相关性及分类（绝对值≥4000 ms·μV为异常），采用Friedman检验等统计方法。
AI.result: PNTV1在1个月时较30分钟增加（60±25 vs 58±19 ms；P=0.018），3个月恢复基线（57±19 ms；P=0.83；Friedman P=0.031）。PNAV1无变化（P=0.37）。PWTFV1绝对值在1个月时短暂增大（-4294±2545 vs -4079±2138 ms·μV；P=0.022），3个月恢复正常（-4039±2060 ms·μV；P=0.64）。PWTFV1与左房直径无相关性（所有|ρ|≈0.05，P≥0.61），分类无变化（57/108例始终异常；无患者重新分类）。
AI.conclusion: 持续性房颤电复律后PWTFV1呈现短暂、由时限驱动的变异，1个月达峰，变化幅度小，不改变分类，且与左房大小无关，提示心房持续恢复而非稳定重构；以PWTFV1作为连续指标解读时需注意评估时机，但研究为回顾性、样本量有限，结论需前瞻性验证。

title: Semaglutide in Atrial Arrhythmias: State of the Art and Future Perspectives
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias, particularly atrial fibrillation (AF), represent a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, especially in individuals with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2D), obesity, and cardiovascular disease. Traditional antiarrhythmic drugs (AADs) remain the cornerstone of rhythm control, but their efficacy is limited and often accompanied by adverse effects. A multidimensional approach that includes upstream therapy—targeting metabolic, structural and inflammatory substrates—has therefore emerged as a critical strategy in arrhythmia prevention and management. Among novel therapeutic agents, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), particularly semaglutide, are gaining attention for their potential antiarrhythmic properties beyond glycaemic control. This review discusses multidimensional arrhythmia management, current indications for semaglutide, and future perspectives on its role as a potential upstream antiarrhythmic therapy.

AI.tldr: 本综述指出，司美格鲁肽等GLP-1受体激动剂在血糖控制之外可能具有上游抗心律失常作用，有望成为房颤综合管理的新策略，但现有证据仍限于综述层面，尚缺乏硬终点RCT支持。
AI.motivation: 房颤是全球范围内致病和致死的重要原因，在2型糖尿病、肥胖和心血管疾病人群中尤为突出。传统抗心律失常药物仍是节律控制的基石，但疗效有限且不良反应常见，因此针对代谢、结构和炎症基质的上游治疗成为心律失常防治的关键策略。GLP-1受体激动剂尤其是司美格鲁肽在血糖控制之外的心脏保护与潜在抗心律失常作用受到关注，但其在房颤管理中的定位尚不明确，本文旨在梳理现有证据并展望未来方向。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，非原始临床研究，摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入文献数量、研究对象样本量、干预对照设置及终点定义，亦未报告任何统计分析方法或效应量计算方式。综述内容涵盖多维度的房颤管理策略、司美格鲁肽当前适应证，以及其作为潜在上游抗心律失常治疗的未来前景。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果，包括未提供司美格鲁肽对房颤发生、复发或负荷影响的效应量、95%置信区间及P值，也未报告任何临床试验终点数据；仅定性指出传统AADs疗效有限且不良反应常见，而GLP-1 RAs（尤其司美格鲁肽）在血糖控制之外显示出潜在抗心律失常特性。
AI.conclusion: 综述认为，以司美格鲁肽为代表的GLP-1 RAs可能通过改善代谢、结构和炎症基质发挥上游抗心律失常作用，支持将其纳入房颤的多维度综合管理框架。对电生理实践而言，这提示在合并2型糖尿病、肥胖或心血管疾病的房颤患者中应重视代谢干预，但现有证据以机制推断和间接数据为主，缺乏以房颤复发或负荷为主要终点的随机对照试验，其抗心律失常疗效与安全性仍需前瞻性研究验证。

title: Hypertension, Atrial Fibrillation, and Orthostatic Hypotension in Older Adults: Blood Pressure Assessment and Treatment Decisions—A Narrative Review
summary: Background and Objectives: Hypertension, atrial fibrillation (AF), and orthostatic hypotension (OH) are common in older adults and may coexist. Their coexistence challenges blood pressure (BP) assessment and treatment decisions because AF reduces measurement reproducibility, OH introduces posture-dependent BP changes, and therapies for hypertension or AF may affect orthostatic tolerance. This review examines evidence relevant to BP assessment and treatment decisions in this setting. Materials and Methods: A focused narrative review was conducted using targeted PubMed searches, supplemented by contemporary cardiovascular guidelines, scientific statements, consensus documents, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and original studies. Results: Hypertension frequently coexists with OH in older adults, while AF adds marked beat-to-beat BP variability and reduces the reproducibility of BP readings. Orthostatic assessment identifies clinically relevant BP falls not captured by seated BP alone. Across hypertension trials, baseline OH did not appear to diminish the cardiovascular benefit of BP lowering, although frail older adults and patients with symptomatic, severe, or neurogenic OH were underrepresented. Effects on orthostatic tolerance differ by drug class and mechanism. β-blockers may blunt compensatory heart-rate responses but may still be required for AF rate control. Frailty and falls influence treatment tolerance and bleeding risk, while the fall risk alone does not generally justify withholding indicated anticoagulation. Conclusions: In older adults with hypertension, AF, and OH, treatment decisions should be guided by BP assessment that captures rhythm-related measurement variability and postural BP change. OH should prompt reassessment of the BP profile, symptoms, and contributing medications rather than automatic antihypertensive deintensification. Medication review should distinguish reversible contributors to orthostatic intolerance from therapies with compelling cardiovascular indications, while frailty, falls, and anticoagulation should inform risk–benefit assessment. Prospective studies are needed to establish how BP and hypertension can be reliably assessed in older adults with coexisting AF and OH and how such assessment should guide treatment.

AI.tldr: 在合并高血压、房颤和体位性低血压的老年人中，血压评估需兼顾节律相关变异和体位性变化，体位性低血压不应自动导致降压治疗降阶，而应重新评估血压谱、症状和药物。
AI.motivation: 高血压、房颤和体位性低血压在老年人中常见且常共存，三者共存使血压评估和治疗决策复杂化：房颤降低测量可重复性，体位性低血压引入体位依赖的血压变化，而高血压或房颤治疗可能影响直立耐受。既往证据缺乏针对这一人群的血压评估和治疗决策指导。
AI.method: 采用聚焦性叙述性综述，通过针对性PubMed检索，并补充当代心血管指南、科学声明、共识文件、系统评价、荟萃分析和原始研究。未报告系统评价方法学细节、纳入研究数量或样本量。
AI.result: 高血压常与体位性低血压共存，房颤增加明显的心搏间血压变异并降低血压读数可重复性。体位评估可识别坐位血压未捕捉到的临床相关血压下降。在高血压试验中，基线体位性低血压未削弱降压的心血管获益，但衰弱老年人和有症状、严重或神经源性体位性低血压患者代表性不足。不同药物类别和机制对直立耐受的影响不同；β受体阻滞剂可能减弱代偿性心率反应，但房颤心率控制仍可能需要。衰弱和跌倒影响治疗耐受性和出血风险，但仅跌倒风险通常不构成不给予有指征抗凝的理由。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 对于合并高血压、房颤和体位性低血压的老年人，治疗决策应基于能捕捉节律相关测量变异和体位性血压变化的血压评估。体位性低血压应促使重新评估血压谱、症状和 contributing 药物，而非自动降阶降压治疗。药物审查应区分可逆性直立不耐受因素与具有明确心血管指征的治疗，同时衰弱、跌倒和抗凝应纳入风险-获益评估。需要前瞻性研究确定如何可靠评估此类患者的血压及指导治疗。

背景与目的：高血压、心房颤动（AF）和直立性低血压（OH）在老年人中常见，且可能共存。它们的共存对血压（BP）评估和治疗决策提出了挑战，因为AF降低了测量的可重复性，OH引入了体位依赖性的血压变化，而高血压或AF的治疗可能影响直立耐受性。本综述探讨了在这种情况下与血压评估和治疗决策相关的证据。

材料与方法：通过针对性的PubMed检索进行了一项聚焦的叙述性综述，并辅以当代心血管指南、科学声明、共识文件、系统综述、荟萃分析和原始研究。

结果：高血压在老年人中常与OH共存，而AF增加了显著的逐搏血压变异性并降低了血压读数的可重复性。直立评估可识别单独坐位血压未捕获的临床相关血压下降。在高血压试验中，基线OH似乎并未减弱降压的心血管获益，尽管衰弱老年人和有症状、严重或神经源性OH的患者代表性不足。对直立耐受性的影响因药物类别和机制而异。β受体阻滞剂可能减弱代偿性心率反应，但可能仍需要用于AF的心率控制。衰弱和跌倒影响治疗耐受性和出血风险，而仅跌倒风险通常不能证明不进行指示性抗凝是合理的。

结论：在患有高血压、AF和OH的老年人中，治疗决策应基于能够捕捉节律相关测量变异性和体位性血压变化的血压评估。OH应促使重新评估血压特征、症状和 contributing 药物，而不是自动降低降压治疗强度。药物审查应区分直立不耐受的可逆因素与具有强烈心血管适应症的治疗，同时衰弱、跌倒和抗凝应纳入风险-获益评估。需要前瞻性研究来确定如何在共存AF和OH的老年人中可靠地评估血压和高血压，以及这种评估应如何指导治疗。

title: Evaluación morfométrica de la función biauricular en pacientes con fibrilación auricular revertidos a ritmo sinusal
summary: Introduction: atrial fibrillation is the most common sustained arrhythmia in clinical practice, and its management continues to evolve rapidly. This frequent cardiac rhythm disturbance accounts for approximately one-third of hospitalizations due to cardiac arrhythmia. Objective: to morphometrically assess biatrial function via echocardiography in patients with atrial fibrillation following sinus rhythm recovery after pharmacological or electrical cardioversion. Methods: an observational, descriptive, cross-sectional study was conducted in the cardiology service of the Celia Sánchez Manduley Provincial Hospital in Granma, Cuba, during the period 2022-2024. The population consisted of patients admitted to the coronary care unit of cardiology with recent-onset atrial fibrillation who were cardioverted to sinus rhythm. Descriptive statistics were used for data analysis by calculating absolute frequencies and relative percentages. Results: pharmacological cardioversion was the most used antiarrhythmic treatment. The echocardiographic study revealed that both the left and right atrial diameters did not change following the applied antiarrhythmic therapy; the area and volume of the left atrium also remained unchanged in these patients. Conclusions: atrial fibrillation poses a challenge for the medical community. It is more frequent after the fifth decade of life, and pharmacological cardioversion constitutes the most widely used medical treatment. Echocardiographic parameters remain within normal values, with biatrial function staying stable after the use of cardioversion.

AI.result: 药物复律是最常用的抗心律失常治疗方式。超声心动图显示，应用抗心律失常治疗复律后左、右心房直径均无变化，左心房面积和容积亦保持不变。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间及P值。
