title: Population Mortality Involving Co-Reported Intracerebral Hemorrhage and Atrial Fibrillation or Flutter in the United States, 1999–2025: Trends, Demographic Disparities, and Forecasts to 2040
summary: INTRODUCTION: Atrial fibrillation (AF) increases the risk of anticoagulation-associated intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH), yet contemporary national mortality trends specific to this overlap remain undercharacterized. Temporal, demographic, and geographic trends in ICH mortality among patients with concomitant AF in the United States from 1999 to 2025, with projections to 2040, were examined. METHODS: A retrospective analysis of death certificate data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Wide-ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research (CDC WONDER) database was conducted, identifying deaths listing ICH (International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision [ICD-10] code I61) and AF (ICD-10 code I48) in any cause-of-death field. Age-adjusted mortality rates were calculated per 100,000 population and stratified by sex, race/ethnicity, census region, and urbanization. Joinpoint regression assessed temporal trends, and autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) models projected rates through 2040. RESULTS: From 1999 to 2025, 52,967 deaths were identified. The overall age-adjusted mortality rate rose from 0.4 to 0.7 per 100,000 between 1999 and 2021 (annual percent change [APC] 1.53%, p=0.016) before stabilizing through 2025. Mortality was consistently higher among men and rose significantly across the study period among Black or African American individuals (APC 1.83%, p<0.000001). Nonmetropolitan areas and the West and South regions carried the highest burden, while the Northeast declined after 2015. State rates ranged from 0.3 in Louisiana to 1.1 in Vermont, and most deaths occurred in medical facilities. CONCLUSIONS: Mortality from ICH among patients with AF rose substantially before stabilizing, with persistent disparities by sex, race, and geography. Projections through 2040 indicate stable rates but a growing absolute burden, underscoring the need for equitable hypertension control and anticoagulation management.

AI.tldr: 1999-2025年美国ICH合并AF的年龄调整死亡率从0.4升至0.7/10万后趋稳，男性、黑人、非都市区及西部/南部负担更高，2040年绝对死亡数将增长。
AI.motivation: AF增加抗凝相关ICH风险，但针对ICH合并AF这一特定人群的全国性死亡率趋势、人口学差异及未来预测尚缺乏系统描述，既往证据不足以指导公平的抗凝与血压管理。
AI.method: 基于CDC WONDER死亡证明数据库的回顾性分析，纳入1999-2025年任何死因字段中同时记录ICH（ICD-10 I61）和AF（ICD-10 I48）的死亡，共52,967例。计算每10万人口的年龄调整死亡率，按性别、种族/族裔、普查区域和城市化分层；采用Joinpoint回归评估时间趋势，ARIMA模型预测至2040年。
AI.result: 年龄调整死亡率从1999年0.4/10万升至2021年0.7/10万（APC 1.53%，p=0.016），此后至2025年趋稳。男性死亡率持续更高；黑人/非裔美国人死亡率显著上升（APC 1.83%，p<0.000001）。非都市区及西部、南部区域负担最重，东北部2015年后下降。州级死亡率从路易斯安那州0.3/10万至佛蒙特州1.1/10万，多数死亡发生在医疗机构。
AI.conclusion: AF患者ICH死亡率在趋稳前显著上升，性别、种族和地理差异持续存在；2040年预测率稳定但绝对负担增长，提示需加强公平的高血压控制和抗凝管理。本研究为死亡证明回顾性分析，存在编码依赖和混杂局限，不能推断因果关系。

summary_zh: 引言：心房颤动（AF）增加抗凝相关脑出血（ICH）的风险，然而针对这一重叠情况的当代全国死亡率趋势仍缺乏充分描述。本研究考察了1999年至2025年美国合并AF患者中ICH死亡率的时间、人口学和地理趋势，并预测至2040年。方法：对疾病控制与预防中心流行病学研究广泛在线数据（CDC WONDER）数据库中的死亡证明数据进行回顾性分析，识别任何死因字段中列出ICH（国际疾病分类第十版[ICD-10]代码I61）和AF（ICD-10代码I48）的死亡记录。计算每10万人口的年龄调整死亡率，并按性别、种族/民族、人口普查区域和城市化程度分层。Joinpoint回归评估时间趋势，自回归积分滑动平均（ARIMA）模型预测至2040年的率。结果：1999年至2025年，共识别52,967例死亡。总体年龄调整死亡率从1999年的0.4/10万上升至2021年的0.7/10万（年度百分比变化[APC] 1.53%，p=0.016），随后至2025年趋于稳定。男性死亡率始终较高，且在研究期间黑人/非裔美国人个体中显著上升（APC 1.83%，p<0.000001）。非大都市地区以及西部和南部地区负担最高，而东北部在2015年后下降。各州率从路易斯安那州的0.3到佛蒙特州的1.1不等，大多数死亡发生在医疗机构。结论：AF患者中ICH死亡率在趋于稳定前大幅上升，性别、种族和地理差异持续存在。至2040年的预测表明率将保持稳定但绝对负担增长，强调需要公平的高血压控制和抗凝管理。

title: Multiple Accessory Pathways in Children: Electrophysiological Features and Catheter Ablation Outcomes.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Multiple accessory pathways (MAPs) may complicate electrophysiological assessment and catheter ablation in pediatric patients. We aimed to evaluate the clinical and electrophysiological characteristics, anatomical distribution, and procedural and follow-up outcomes of pediatric patients with MAPs.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study included pediatric patients with at least two distinct accessory pathways identified during EPS between November 2019 and February 2026.

RESULTS: Of 1101 patients who underwent catheter ablation, 619 had accessory pathway-related arrhythmias; among these, 31 (5.0%) had MAPs. The mean age and body weight at the first procedure were 12.1 ± 3.6 years and 44.2 ± 18.8 kg, respectively, and 16 patients were female. Nine patients had structural heart disease, including seven with Ebstein anomaly. A total of 66 accessory pathways were identified: 28 patients had two pathways, two had three, and one had four. The right posteroseptal region was the most common pathway location (27.3%). One patient also had atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia. Complete elimination of all accessory pathways was achieved in 29 of 31 patients (93.5%), and 63 of 66 pathways (95.5%) were successfully ablated. Recurrence occurred in six patients (19.4%). No procedure-related complications were observed during a mean follow-up of 26.3 ± 18.7 months.

CONCLUSION: MAPs were successfully treated with high acute success rates and no procedure-related complications. Nevertheless, recurrence and the identification of additional accessory pathways during subsequent evaluations remained clinically relevant, supporting the need for systematic post-ablation reassessment and long-term follow-up.

AI.tldr: 儿童多旁路（MAPs）占旁路相关心律失常患儿的5.0%，急性消融成功率高（患者93.5%、旁路95.5%）且无并发症，但复发率19.4%，需系统术后复查与长期随访。
AI.motivation: 儿童多旁路可增加电生理评估与导管消融的难度，既往对其临床电生理特征、解剖分布及消融结局的系统性证据有限，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2019年11月至2026年2月电生理检查中确认至少两条独立旁路的儿童患者；共1101例行导管消融，619例为旁路相关心律失常，其中31例（5.0%）为多旁路。终点为急性消融成功率（患者及旁路水平）、复发率与手术相关并发症，平均随访26.3±18.7个月。
AI.result: 31例患者平均年龄12.1±3.6岁、体重44.2±18.8 kg，女性16例；9例合并结构性心脏病（7例Ebstein畸形）。共识别66条旁路：28例2条、2例3条、1例4条；右后间隔最常见（27.3%）；1例合并房室结折返性心动过速。患者水平完全消融29/31（93.5%），旁路水平63/66（95.5%）；复发6例（19.4%）；随访期间无手术相关并发症。
AI.conclusion: 儿童多旁路经导管消融可获得高急性成功率且无并发症，但复发及后续评估中新发现旁路仍具临床意义，提示需系统化术后再评估与长期随访；本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量小，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：多发性旁路（MAPs）可能使儿科患者的电生理评估和导管消融复杂化。我们旨在评估多发性旁路儿科患者的临床和电生理特征、解剖分布以及手术和随访结局。

材料与方法：这项回顾性研究纳入了2019年11月至2026年2月期间在电生理检查（EPS）中识别出至少两条不同旁路的儿科患者。

结果：在1101例接受导管消融的患者中，619例存在旁路相关心律失常；其中31例（5.0%）存在多发性旁路。首次手术时的平均年龄和体重分别为12.1 ± 3.6岁和44.2 ± 18.8 kg，16例为女性。9例患者存在结构性心脏病，包括7例Ebstein畸形。共识别出66条旁路：28例患者有两条旁路，2例有三条，1例有四条。右后间隔区域是最常见的旁路位置（27.3%）。1例患者还合并房室结折返性心动过速。31例患者中有29例（93.5%）实现了所有旁路的完全消除，66条旁路中有63条（95.5%）成功消融。6例患者（19.4%）出现复发。在平均26.3 ± 18.7个月的随访期间，未观察到手术相关并发症。

结论：多发性旁路被成功治疗，急性成功率高且无手术相关并发症。然而，复发以及在后续评估中识别出额外旁路仍具有临床意义，支持需要进行系统性的消融后重新评估和长期随访。

title: Long-Term Outcomes of AV Node Ablation Plus CRT Compared to AF Catheter Ablation in Patients With AF and HFrEF
summary: Background Catheter ablation is an established rhythm-control strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), while atrioventricular node ablation with cardiac resynchronization therapy (AVNA+CRT) is often used in older patients with advanced disease when durable rhythm control is less feasible. Comparative long-term outcomes remain unclear.Methods Using the TriNetX Research Network, we identified adults with HFrEF and AF from 2016 who underwent AF ablation or AVNA+CRT from 2016-2023 and 2016-2020 for the 2- and 5-year analysis, respectively. Propensity score matching was performed separately using 58 prespecified covariates. Outcomes included embolic events (stroke/systemic embolism), all-cause mortality, heart failure (HF) hospitalization, and heart transplant/left ventricular assist device (LVAD) implantation.Results The 2-year cohort included 16,276 patients (2899 AVNA+CRT; 13,377 AF ablation); the 5-year cohort included 7370 patients (1463 AVNA+CRT; 5907 AF Ablation). After matching, AVNA+CRT was associated with higher all-cause mortality (RR 1.580, 95% CI 1.389-1.799), HF hospitalization (RR 1.106, 95% CI 1.040-1.176), and heart transplant/LVAD implantation (RR 2.381, 95% CI 1.142-4.975), with no difference in embolic events at 2 years. At 5 years, AVNA+CRT remained associated with higher mortality (RR 1.350, 95% CI 1.198-1.522; p < 0.001), while HF hospitalization, embolic events, and heart transplant/LVAD implantation did not differ significantly.Conclusion In a large propensity matched HFrEF-AF cohort, AVNA+CRT was associated with higher mortality at 2 and 5 years than AF ablation, with excess HF hospitalization and transplant/LVAD at 2 years, whereas HF hospitalization rates were similar at 5 years. Prospective studies are needed to refine patient selection in older, medically complex patients.

AI.tldr: 在HFrEF合并AF患者中，AVNA+CRT与AF消融相比，2年和5年全因死亡率均更高，2年心衰住院和心脏移植/LVAD植入也更多。
AI.motivation: AF消融是AF合并HFrEF患者确立的节律控制策略，而AVNA+CRT常用于高龄、晚期、难以实现持久节律控制的患者，但两者长期结局的比较证据不足。
AI.method: 基于TriNetX研究网络的回顾性队列研究，纳入2016年起HFrEF合并AF的成人，分别接受AF消融或AVNA+CRT，2年队列（2016-2023年）和5年队列（2016-2020年）分别用58个预设协变量进行倾向性评分匹配。终点包括栓塞事件（卒中/体循环栓塞）、全因死亡、心衰住院和心脏移植/LVAD植入。
AI.result: 2年队列共16,276例（AVNA+CRT 2,899例；AF消融13,377例）；5年队列共7,370例（AVNA+CRT 1,463例；AF消融5,907例）。匹配后，AVNA+CRT与更高的全因死亡（RR 1.580，95%CI 1.389-1.799）、心衰住院（RR 1.106，95%CI 1.040-1.176）和心脏移植/LVAD植入（RR 2.381，95%CI 1.142-4.975）相关，2年栓塞事件无差异。5年时AVNA+CRT仍与更高死亡相关（RR 1.350，95%CI 1.198-1.522；p<0.001），其中心衰住院、栓塞事件和心脏移植/LVAD植入无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 在大规模倾向性匹配的HFrEF-AF队列中，AVNA+CRT与AF消融相比，2年和5年死亡率更高，2年心衰住院和移植/LVAD更多，5年心衰住院率相似。需前瞻性研究优化高龄、复杂患者的治疗选择。

summary_zh:
背景：导管消融是心房颤动（AF）合并射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）的既定节律控制策略，而房室结消融联合心脏再同步治疗（AVNA+CRT）常用于高龄、疾病进展期且持久节律控制可行性较低的患者。两者的长期结局比较仍不明确。

方法：利用TriNetX Research Network，我们筛选了2016年起患有HFrEF和AF的成人患者，分别于2016-2023年和2016-2020年期间接受AF消融或AVNA+CRT，用于2年和5年分析。使用58个预设协变量分别进行倾向性评分匹配。结局包括栓塞事件（卒中/系统性栓塞）、全因死亡、心力衰竭（HF）住院以及心脏移植/左心室辅助装置（LVAD）植入。

结果：2年队列包括16,276例患者（2899例AVNA+CRT；13,377例AF消融）；5年队列包括7370例患者（1463例AVNA+CRT；5907例AF消融）。匹配后，AVNA+CRT与较高的全因死亡（RR 1.580，95% CI 1.389-1.799）、HF住院（RR 1.106，95% CI 1.040-1.176）和心脏移植/LVAD植入（RR 2.381，95% CI 1.142-4.975）相关，2年时栓塞事件无差异。5年时，AVNA+CRT仍与较高的死亡相关（RR 1.350，95% CI 1.198-1.522；p < 0.001），而HF住院、栓塞事件和心脏移植/LVAD植入无显著差异。

结论：在一个大型倾向性匹配的HFrEF-AF队列中，AVNA+CRT在2年和5年时与AF消融相比死亡更高，2年时HF住院和移植/LVAD过多，而5年时HF住院率相似。需要前瞻性研究来优化高龄、医学复杂患者的患者选择。

title: Pulmonary Vein Stenosis Following Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation Presenting With Massive Pleural Effusion: A Case Report
summary: We report a rare case of pulmonary vein stenosis (PVS) presenting with massive pleural effusion 5 months after radiofrequency catheter ablation (RFCA) for atrial fibrillation. A 58-year-old woman developed persistent fever, cough, and left lower lobe consolidation with a large pleural effusion. Initial antibiotic therapy was ineffective. Three-dimensional computed tomography (3D-CT) revealed severe stenosis of the left inferior pulmonary vein. Following balloon angioplasty, both pulmonary consolidation and pleural effusion resolved. Because PVS may present with nonspecific findings and delayed onset, it should be considered in patients with unexplained pulmonary infiltrates or pleural effusion after RFCA.

AI.tldr: 58岁女性房颤射频消融后5个月出现大量胸腔积液，3D-CT确诊左下肺静脉重度狭窄，球囊扩张后积液吸收。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉狭窄是房颤射频消融术后罕见但严重的并发症，临床表现非特异且可延迟出现，易被误诊为感染或心力衰竭，导致延误治疗。既往文献多为病例系列，缺乏对以大量胸腔积液为首发表现的PVS的认识。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为58岁女性，因房颤行射频导管消融，术后5个月出现持续发热、咳嗽、左下叶实变伴大量胸腔积液。初始抗生素治疗无效。通过三维CT明确肺静脉狭窄诊断，并接受球囊扩张术。主要观察指标为影像学改变及临床症状缓解情况。
AI.result: 3D-CT显示左下肺静脉重度狭窄。球囊扩张术后，肺部实变及胸腔积液均完全吸收。摘要未报告狭窄程度的具体数值、球囊扩张参数及随访时间。
AI.conclusion: 射频消融术后PVS可表现为非特异性呼吸道症状和大量胸腔积液，且可延迟出现。对消融术后不明原因肺部浸润或胸腔积液的患者，应警惕PVS并行影像学评估。球囊扩张可有效缓解。局限性为单病例报告，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 我们报告一例罕见的肺静脉狭窄（PVS）病例，该患者在因心房颤动接受射频导管消融（RFCA）后5个月出现大量胸腔积液。一名58岁女性出现持续发热、咳嗽，以及左下叶实变伴大量胸腔积液。初始抗生素治疗无效。三维计算机断层扫描（3D-CT）显示左下肺静脉严重狭窄。经球囊血管成形术后，肺部实变和胸腔积液均消退。由于PVS可能表现为非特异性表现且起病延迟，对于RFCA后出现不明原因肺部浸润或胸腔积液的患者，应考虑该诊断。

title: Relationship between Positional Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Excessive Daytime Sleepiness in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
PURPOSE: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is highly prevalent in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Prior studies suggest that excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS), a common symptom of OSA, is less pronounced in patients with AF. This study focused on a subtype of OSA, positional OSA (POSA), and examined its association with EDS overall and separately in patients with and without AF.

METHODS: This study included 222 OSA patients with and without AF history who underwent in-lab polysomnography. POSA was defined using three criteria: conventional POSA (cPOSA; supine/non-supine apnea-hypopnea index [AHI] ratio ≥ 2), intermediately conservative POSA (iPOSA; supine/non-supine AHI ratio ≥ 3), and exclusive POSA (ePOSA; supine/non-supine AHI ratio ≥ 2 and non-supine AHI < 5 events/h). EDS was determined by an Epworth Sleepiness Scale score ≥ 11. Logistic regression was performed to assess the associations.

RESULTS: Overall, 55.4% of patients had cPOSA, and 43.6% reported EDS. Analysis of the entire cohort showed that patients with cPOSA (adjusted odds ratio [aOR]: 0.51, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.26-0.98) or iPOSA (aOR: 0.37, 95% CI: 0.18-0.74) had lower odds of EDS than their non-POSA counterparts. Among patients with AF, cPOSA was associated with lower odds of EDS (aOR: 0.32, 95% CI: 0.11-0.90). Among patients without AF, iPOSA was associated with lower odds of EDS (aOR: 0.28, 95% CI: 0.10-0.75).

CONCLUSION: The association between POSA and EDS varied by POSA definitions and AF status. The findings suggest that EDS manifests differently by cPOSA status in patients with AF.

AI.tldr: 在222例OSA患者中，体位性OSA（POSA）与日间过度嗜睡（EDS）呈负相关，且该关联因POSA定义和是否合并房颤而不同，房颤患者中cPOSA者EDS风险更低。
AI.motivation: OSA在房颤患者中高发，既往提示房颤患者的EDS症状较轻，但POSA这一亚型与EDS的关系及其在房颤与非房颤患者中的差异尚不清楚，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 回顾性纳入222例经实验室多导睡眠监测确诊的OSA患者（含或不含房颤病史）。POSA按三种标准定义：cPOSA（仰卧位/非仰卧位AHI比值≥2）、iPOSA（比值≥3）、ePOSA（比值≥2且非仰卧位AHI<5次/h）。EDS定义为Epworth嗜睡量表评分≥11。采用logistic回归评估关联。
AI.result: 全队列中55.4%为cPOSA，43.6%存在EDS。整体分析显示cPOSA（aOR 0.51，95%CI 0.26-0.98）和iPOSA（aOR 0.37，95%CI 0.18-0.74）患者EDS风险低于非POSA者。房颤亚组中cPOSA与EDS风险降低相关（aOR 0.32，95%CI 0.11-0.90）；非房颤亚组中iPOSA与EDS风险降低相关（aOR 0.28，95%CI 0.10-0.75）。
AI.conclusion: POSA与EDS的关联因POSA定义和房颤状态而异，房颤患者的EDS表现随cPOSA状态不同而不同。提示临床在房颤合并OSA患者中不应仅凭EDS症状判断OSA严重程度，需结合睡眠监测；本研究为单中心横断面设计，因果推断受限，ePOSA相关结果摘要未报告。

summary_zh:
目的：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）在心房颤动（AF）患者中高度流行。既往研究表明，OSA的常见症状——日间过度嗜睡（EDS）在AF患者中较不明显。本研究聚焦于OSA的一种亚型——体位性OSA（POSA），并探讨其与EDS的总体关联，以及在合并与不合并AF患者中的分别关联。

方法：本研究纳入222例接受实验室多导睡眠监测的OSA患者，包括有AF病史和无AF病史者。POSA采用三种标准定义：传统POSA（cPOSA；仰卧位/非仰卧位呼吸暂停低通气指数[AHI]比值≥2）、中间保守POSA（iPOSA；仰卧位/非仰卧位AHI比值≥3）和严格POSA（ePOSA；仰卧位/非仰卧位AHI比值≥2且非仰卧位AHI<5次/小时）。EDS由Epworth嗜睡量表评分≥11分确定。采用逻辑回归评估关联。

结果：总体而言，55.4%的患者有cPOSA，43.6%报告EDS。对整个队列的分析显示，cPOSA（校正比值比[aOR]：0.51，95%置信区间[CI]：0.26-0.98）或iPOSA（aOR：0.37，95% CI：0.18-0.74）患者发生EDS的比值低于非POSA患者。在AF患者中，cPOSA与较低的EDS比值相关（aOR：0.32，95% CI：0.11-0.90）。在无AF患者中，iPOSA与较低的EDS比值相关（aOR：0.28，95% CI：0.10-0.75）。

结论：POSA与EDS之间的关联因POSA定义和AF状态而异。研究结果表明，在AF患者中，EDS的表现因cPOSA状态而不同。

title: Wolff-Parkinson-White Pattern: Recognition of Ventricular Pre-Excitation and Risk Stratification
summary: Background: Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) pattern is characterized by ventricular pre-excitation through an accessory atrioventricular pathway. Although often asymptomatic, some pathways carry a risk of tachyarrhythmia and sudden cardiac death. Case Description: A 45-year-old man with hypertension, polysubstance use, and bipolar disorder presented with altered mental status following suspected substance intoxication. His course was complicated by hypoxic respiratory failure requiring intubation and a large right basal ganglia hemorrhage requiring surgical evacuation. During hospitalization, an abnormal ECG prompted Cardiology consultation. The ECG demonstrated sinus rhythm with a short PR interval, delta wave, and widened QRS complex, consistent with ventricular pre-excitation. He had no documented tachyarrhythmia, palpitations, syncope, exertional symptoms, or family history of sudden cardiac death. Discussion: In the absence of symptoms or documented arrhythmia, the findings were consistent with an asymptomatic WPW pattern rather than WPW syndrome. Risk stratification is important because accessory pathways capable of rapid antegrade conduction can facilitate pre-excited atrial fibrillation and potentially ventricular fibrillation. Exercise testing may identify lower-risk pathways through abrupt loss of pre-excitation, while persistent or indeterminate pre-excitation may warrant electrophysiologic evaluation. Conclusion: This case emphasizes the importance of recognizing incidental ventricular pre-excitation and distinguishing WPW pattern from WPW syndrome. Appropriate risk stratification and follow-up can identify patients at increased arrhythmic risk and guide consideration of definitive catheter ablation.

AI.tldr: 一例45岁男性因意识改变入院，心电图偶然发现无症状性WPW模式，强调需区分WPW模式与综合征并进行风险分层。
AI.motivation: WPW模式由房室旁路导致心室预激，常无症状，但部分旁路有快速前传能力，可引发预激性房颤甚至室颤和猝死。临床需识别无症状性预激并区分WPW模式与WPW综合征，以指导风险分层和是否行导管消融。
AI.method: 本文为个案报告。对象为45岁男性，有高血压、多种物质使用和双相情感障碍史，因疑似物质中毒后意识改变入院，病程中并发低氧性呼吸衰竭需插管和右侧基底节区大出血需手术清除。住院期间心电图异常请心内科会诊。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 心电图示窦性心律，PR间期缩短、delta波和QRS波增宽，符合心室预激。患者无记录到的心动过速、心悸、晕厥、劳力性症状或猝死家族史。摘要未报告具体心电图测量值、风险分层检查结果或随访数据。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示应识别偶然发现的心室预激，并区分WPW模式与WPW综合征。对无症状WPW模式应进行风险分层：运动试验中预激波突然消失提示旁路低危，持续或不确定者需电生理检查评估。适当风险分层和随访可识别心律失常高危患者，指导是否行根治性导管消融。局限性为单一个案，结论不能推广。

summary_zh: 背景：Wolff-Parkinson-White（WPW）模式的特征是经房室旁路引起的室性预激。尽管通常无症状，但某些旁路存在快速性心律失常和心源性猝死的风险。病例描述：一名45岁男性，有高血压、多种物质使用和双相情感障碍病史，因疑似物质中毒后精神状态改变就诊。其病程并发缺氧性呼吸衰竭需插管，以及右侧基底节区大面积出血需手术清除。住院期间，异常心电图促使心内科会诊。心电图显示窦性心律，PR间期缩短，delta波，QRS波群增宽，符合室性预激。他没有记录到快速性心律失常、心悸、晕厥、劳力性症状或心源性猝死家族史。讨论：在无症状或未记录到心律失常的情况下，这些发现符合无症状性WPW模式而非WPW综合征。风险分层很重要，因为能够快速前向传导的旁路可促进预激性心房颤动并可能诱发心室颤动。运动试验可能通过预激突然消失来识别较低风险的旁路，而持续或不确定的预激可能需要电生理评估。结论：本病例强调了识别偶然发现的室性预激以及区分WPW模式与WPW综合征的重要性。适当的风险分层和随访可以识别心律失常风险增加的患者，并指导考虑确定性导管消融。

title: Substrate-Dependent Pro- and Antiarrhythmic Action of Omecamtiv Mecarbil at the Ventricular and Atrial Level: Insights from a Langendorff-Perfused Rabbit Heart Model.
summary: Omecamtiv mecarbil is a cardiac-selective myosin activator and potential heart failure treatment, but its electrophysiological profile remains incompletely characterized. We investigated omecamtiv mecarbil in a Langendorff-perfused rabbit heart model. Forty-eight rabbit hearts were retrogradely perfused; twenty-four in a ventricular and twenty-four in an atrial setup. In the ventricular setup, action potential duration at 90% repolarization (APD90), QT interval, and dispersion of repolarization were assessed during pacing at seven cycle lengths. After baseline recordings, Group 1 (n = 12) received 1, 5 and 10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil sequentially, while Group 2 (n = 12) received 100 µM sotalol followed by 5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil. In the atrial setup, Group 3 (n = 12) received 5 and 10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil, and Group 4 (n = 12) received isoproterenol/acetylcholine (IsoACh) to increase atrial fibrillation (AF) susceptibility, followed by 5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil. Omecamtiv mecarbil alone shortened ventricular APD90 and QT interval, increased dispersion of repolarization, and raised ventricular arrhythmia incidence. Sotalol prolonged APD90, QT interval, and dispersion, with a marked rise in VT episodes; additional omecamtiv mecarbil did not further prolong repolarization but increased arrhythmia susceptibility further. In the atrial setup, omecamtiv mecarbil alone prolonged conduction time and increased AF inducibility. Under IsoACh, which shortened atrial APD and refractoriness and increased AF episodes, additional omecamtiv mecarbil slowed atrial conduction and markedly suppressed AF. In summary, omecamtiv mecarbil was proarrhythmic at the ventricular level, particularly under reduced repolarization reserve, but showed antiarrhythmic effects in an IsoACh-induced AF model and proarrhythmic properties in the healthy atrium, indicating a substrate-dependent electrophysiological profile.

AI.tldr: 在Langendorff灌流兔心中，omecamtiv mecarbil在心室水平缩短复极、增加离散度而致心律失常，在异丙肾上腺素/乙酰胆碱诱导的房颤模型中却抑制房颤，呈现基质依赖性电生理作用。
AI.motivation: Omecamtiv mecarbil是心脏选择性肌球蛋白激活剂，有望治疗心力衰竭，但其电生理特征尚未完全明确，尤其对心室和心房心律失常易感性的影响缺乏系统数据。
AI.method: 采用Langendorff灌流兔心模型，共48颗心脏，心室组24颗、心房组24颗。心室组在7个起搏周期长度下评估APD90、QT间期和复极离散度；Group 1（n=12）序贯给予1、5、10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil，Group 2（n=12）先给100 µM索他洛尔再给5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil。心房组Group 3（n=12）给予5、10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil，Group 4（n=12）先以异丙肾上腺素/乙酰胆碱（IsoACh）提高房颤易感性，再给5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil。
AI.result: 心室组中，omecamtiv mecarbil单用缩短APD90和QT间期、增加复极离散度并提高室性心律失常发生率；索他洛尔延长APD90、QT间期和离散度并显著增加室速发作，追加omecamtiv mecarbil未进一步延长复极但进一步增加心律失常易感性。心房组中，omecamtiv mecarbil单用延长传导时间并增加房颤可诱发性；在IsoACh缩短心房APD和不应期、增加房颤发作的背景下，追加omecamtiv mecarbil减慢心房传导并显著抑制房颤。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: Omecamtiv mecarbil在心室水平尤其复极储备降低时致心律失常，在IsoACh诱导的房颤模型中抗心律失常，但在健康心房中致心律失常，提示其电生理作用具有基质依赖性；临床应用于心衰患者时需关注心律失常风险，尤其合并复极储备下降者，但本研究为离体兔心模型，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: Omecamtiv mecarbil 是一种心脏选择性肌球蛋白激活剂，也是潜在的心力衰竭治疗药物，但其电生理特征仍未完全明确。我们在 Langendorff 灌注兔心模型中研究了 omecamtiv mecarbil。48 只兔心进行逆行灌注；24 只用于心室设置，24 只用于心房设置。在心室设置中，以七个周期长度起搏时评估 90% 复极时动作电位时程（APD90）、QT 间期和复极离散度。基线记录后，第 1 组（n = 12）依次接受 1、5 和 10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil，而第 2 组（n = 12）接受 100 µM 索他洛尔后接受 5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil。在心房设置中，第 3 组（n = 12）接受 5 和 10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil，第 4 组（n = 12）接受异丙肾上腺素/乙酰胆碱（IsoACh）以增加心房颤动（AF）易感性，随后接受 5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil。单用 omecamtiv mecarbil 缩短了心室 APD90 和 QT 间期，增加了复极离散度，并提高了室性心律失常发生率。索他洛尔延长了 APD90、QT 间期和离散度，并显著增加 VT 发作；额外给予 omecamtiv mecarbil 未进一步延长复极，但进一步增加了心律失常易感性。在心房设置中，单用 omecamtiv mecarbil 延长了传导时间并增加了 AF 可诱发性。在 IsoACh 作用下（其缩短了心房 APD 和不应期并增加了 AF 发作），额外给予 omecamtiv mecarbil 减慢了心房传导并显著抑制了 AF。总之，omecamtiv mecarbil 在心室水平具有致心律失常作用，尤其是在复极储备降低时，但在 IsoACh 诱导的 AF 模型中显示出抗心律失常作用，而在健康心房中具有致心律失常特性，表明其电生理特征具有基质依赖性。

title: Gut microbiota-activated PLCγ2 monocytes drive atrial fibrillation.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained arrhythmia, conferring risks of stroke and heart failure. Monocyte activation-associated inflammation is implicated in AF, yet the recruitment of monocytes and their role in atrial remodeling remain unclear. Here we show that monocytes from AF patients upregulate phospholipase C gamma 2 (PLCG2). In a combined AF male mouse model, phospho-PLCγ2+ monocytes are recruited to the atria, where they trigger endothelial‑to‑mesenchymal transition (EndMT) through the secreted phosphoprotein 1 (SPP1)-integrin α9β1 signaling axis. Monocyte-specific deletion of PLCG2 blocks atrial recruitment of these monocytes and reduces AF. Depletion of the gut microbiota with antibiotics reduces the number of phospho-PLCγ2+ monocytes in the atria, suppresses EndMT, and attenuates AF inducibility, and these effects are reversed by fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT). Mechanistically, gut microbiota-derived bacterial membrane vesicles activate spleen tyrosine kinase (Syk)/PLCG2 signaling in monocytes. These findings establish a gut microbiota-monocyte-EndMT axis, wherein monocyte-endocardial crosstalk drives AF.

AI.tldr: 房颤患者单核细胞PLCγ2上调，肠道菌群通过膜囊泡激活Syk/PLCG2促进单核细胞心房募集并诱导内皮间质转化，驱动房颤。
AI.motivation: 单核细胞活化相关炎症参与房颤，但单核细胞募集机制及其在心房重构中的作用尚不清楚，既往缺乏从肠道菌群到单核细胞再到心房重构的完整通路证据。
AI.method: 研究纳入房颤患者单核细胞分析PLCG2表达；采用雄性房颤小鼠模型，通过单核细胞特异性PLCG2敲除、抗生素清除肠道菌群及粪菌移植（FMT）干预，评估心房phospho-PLCγ2+单核细胞募集、内皮间质转化（EndMT）及房颤诱发率；机制上检测细菌膜囊泡对单核细胞Syk/PLCG2信号的激活。
AI.result: 房颤患者单核细胞PLCG2表达上调；小鼠心房中phospho-PLCγ2+单核细胞浸润，通过SPP1-整合素α9β1轴触发EndMT；单核细胞特异性敲除PLCG2减少单核细胞心房募集并降低房颤；抗生素清除肠道菌群减少心房phospho-PLCγ2+单核细胞、抑制EndMT并降低房颤诱发率，FMT可逆转上述效应；细菌膜囊泡激活单核细胞Syk/PLCG2信号。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立肠道菌群-单核细胞-EndMT轴驱动房颤，提示靶向PLCG2或肠道菌群可能成为房颤防治新策略；但当前证据主要来自动物模型，临床转化需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常，具有卒中和心力衰竭的风险。单核细胞活化相关炎症与AF有关，但单核细胞的募集及其在心房重构中的作用仍不清楚。

方法：在此，我们显示AF患者的单核细胞上调磷脂酶C gamma 2（PLCG2）。在联合AF雄性小鼠模型中，磷酸化PLCγ2+单核细胞被募集到心房，在那里它们通过分泌型磷蛋白1（SPP1）-整合素α9β1信号轴触发内皮-间质转化（EndMT）。

结果：单核细胞特异性敲除PLCG2可阻断这些单核细胞的心房募集并减少AF。用抗生素清除肠道菌群可减少心房中磷酸化PLCγ2+单核细胞的数量，抑制EndMT，并减弱AF可诱导性，而这些效应可被粪便菌群移植（FMT）逆转。机制上，肠道菌群衍生的细菌膜囊泡激活单核细胞中的脾酪氨酸激酶（Syk）/PLCG2信号。

结论：这些发现建立了一个肠道菌群-单核细胞-EndMT轴，其中单核细胞-心内膜串扰驱动AF。

title: Supraventricular Tachycardia Associated with Cardiac Hemangioma on the Anterior Mitral Valve Leaflet: A Case Report
summary: Background: Cardiac hemangiomas are exceedingly rare benign vascular tumors, representing <2% of primary cardiac tumors. Case Presentation: A 65-year-old female patient with a history of palpitations, hypothyroidism, and hypoparathyroidism presented with an acute onset of palpitations and dyspnea. On physical examination, the patient had regular tachycardia with clear and equal bilateral air entry. Initial laboratory tests and chest X-ray showed no acute abnormalities. An electrocardiogram (ECG) showed narrow-complex supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) with a heart rate of 170 bpm and a QRS duration of 80 ms, consistent with atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT), which was unresponsive to vagal maneuvers but was successfully converted with 6 mg of intravenous adenosine. Multimodality imaging, including transthoracic echocardiography (TTE), transesophageal echocardiography (TEE), and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR), was performed. TTE showed a fixed, normoechoic mass (1-1.2 cm) at the aortomitral junction involving the A2 segment of the anterior mitral leaflet; TEE described a nonobstructive heterogeneous echodensity (17 × 6 mm) at the leaflet base near the intervalvular fibrosa; CMR showed a 13 × 11 mm arched structure on the anterior mitral leaflet, beneath the aortic valve, with cavity-like perfusion, T2 hyperintensity, and late gadolinium enhancement. Surgical resection was performed 3 weeks after the diagnosis, and histopathology showed a remodeled remnant hemangioma. Postoperatively, continuous telemetry and long-term clinical and serial ECG follow-up confirmed complete resolution of the arrhythmia without tumor recurrence. Conclusion: We report a cardiac hemangioma on the left atrial side of the anterior mitral leaflet, extending slightly into the left atrial cavity without obstructing blood flow, in a patient with episodes of supraventricular tachycardia. She recovered well after tumor resection, with no clinical signs of arrhythmia recurrence.
journal: Asploro Journal of Biomedical and Clinical Case Reports

AI.tldr: 65岁女性二尖瓣前叶血管瘤患者表现为窄QRS波心动过速，手术切除后心律失常完全消失且无复发。
AI.motivation: 心脏血管瘤是极罕见的良性血管肿瘤，占原发性心脏肿瘤不足2%，其与室上性心动过速的关联及手术切除后心律失常转归的报道有限，临床认识不足。
AI.method: 病例报告。65岁女性，既往心悸、甲状腺功能减退和甲状旁腺功能减退，因急性心悸、呼吸困难就诊。心电图示窄QRS波室上性心动过速，心率170次/分，QRS时限80 ms，符合房室结折返性心动过速，迷走神经刺激无效，静脉腺苷6 mg转复。行经胸超声心动图、经食管超声心动图和心脏磁共振多模态影像评估，并行手术切除，术后病理确诊血管瘤。术后持续心电遥测及长期临床和系列心电图随访。
AI.result: 经胸超声心动图显示主动脉-二尖瓣交界处固定中等回声团块（1-1.2 cm），累及二尖瓣前叶A2段；经食管超声心动图描述为瓣叶基底部近瓣间纤维体处无梗阻性不均匀回声（17×6 mm）；心脏磁共振显示二尖瓣前叶、主动脉瓣下13×11 mm弓形结构，伴腔样灌注、T2高信号和晚期钆增强。诊断后3周行手术切除，组织病理示重构的残留血管瘤。术后持续心电遥测及长期临床和系列心电图随访证实心律失常完全消失，无肿瘤复发。
AI.conclusion: 本病例报告了二尖瓣前叶左房侧心脏血管瘤（稍突入左房腔但未梗阻血流）与室上性心动过速发作相关，肿瘤切除后患者恢复良好，无心律失常复发临床征象。提示对不明原因室上性心动过速患者应关注罕见心脏肿瘤可能，多模态影像有助于诊断，手术切除可根治心律失常；但作为单例病例报告，结论外推受限。

title: Quantitative imaging analysis in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: phenotypic differentiation to prognostic stratification.
summary: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is the most common inherited cardiac disorder and remains associated with sudden cardiac death (SCD), heart failure, and diagnostic uncertainty due to overlap with other causes of left ventricular hypertrophy, including hypertensive heart disease and cardiac amyloidosis. This review aimed to evaluate the evolving applications of radiomics in the context of related quantitative imaging techniques. A review was conducted of studies applying radiomics, texture analysis, machine learning, and deep learning to cardiac imaging in HCM. The evidence base derives predominantly from CMR, with a smaller and more recent body of work in echocardiography and CT. Current evidence suggests that radiomics can extract quantitative features of myocardial texture, shape, and signal heterogeneity beyond visual assessment. These approaches have shown promise in differentiating HCM from phenocopies, identifying myocardial fibrosis without contrast administration, and improving the prediction of adverse outcomes, including SCD and heart failure. Several studies reported incremental value over conventional imaging markers such as wall thickness, global T1 values, and binary late gadolinium enhancement. However, the literature remains limited by retrospective study design, small cohorts, heterogeneity in imaging acquisition and segmentation, and insufficient external validation. Radiomics has emerged as a promising adjunct to conventional cardiac imaging in HCM, with the potential to be adapted into a clinical decision support tool. Its future clinical role will depend on methodological standardization and robust external validation.

AI.tldr: 影像组学可提取心肌纹理、形状和信号异质性等定量特征，在肥厚型心肌病的表型鉴别、无对比剂识别纤维化及预后预测方面展现潜力，但证据受限于回顾性小样本研究且缺乏外部验证。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）是最常见的遗传性心脏病，与心源性猝死（SCD）和心力衰竭相关，且因与高血压性心脏病、心脏淀粉样变性等所致左心室肥厚存在重叠，诊断常不确定。传统影像学指标如壁厚度、整体T1值、二分类晚期钆增强存在局限，需要更精准的定量工具。
AI.method: 本文为综述，系统回顾了应用影像组学、纹理分析、机器学习和深度学习于HCM心脏影像的研究。证据主要来自心脏磁共振（CMR），少数近期研究涉及超声心动图和CT。未报告具体样本量、终点定义或统计方法，因摘要未报告。
AI.result: 现有证据提示影像组学可提取超越视觉评估的心肌纹理、形状和信号异质性定量特征，在区分HCM与表型模拟病、无对比剂识别心肌纤维化、改善不良结局（包括SCD和心力衰竭）预测方面有前景。多项研究报告了相对于壁厚度、整体T1值和二分类晚期钆增强等传统影像标志物的增量价值。但文献受限于回顾性设计、小队列、影像采集和分割异质性以及外部验证不足。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 影像组学已成为HCM传统心脏影像的有前景的辅助工具，有潜力发展为临床决策支持工具。其未来临床角色取决于方法学标准化和稳健的外部验证。当前证据级别有限，尚不足以改变临床实践，需前瞻性多中心研究进一步验证。

title: Delayed cardiac conduction disease in a young adult following childhood Chagas infection.
summary:
PRESENTATION: A Bolivian man in his 30s presented to the ED with non-exertional chest pain and intermittent second-degree atrioventricular (2:1) block.

DIAGNOSIS: Given a history of untreated childhood Trypanosoma cruzi infection and family history of Chagas heart disease, late cardiac manifestation was suspected. Structural and ischaemic causes were excluded.

TREATMENT: Antiparasitic therapy was initiated. Pacemaker implantation was considered but deferred following shared decision-making due to absence of symptoms.

DISCUSSION: Chagas heart disease (CHD) may present decades after infection with conduction abnormalities. Recognition in the ED is essential to enable appropriate management and reduce the risk of progression to complete heart block and sudden cardiac death.

AI.motivation: 恰加斯心脏病可在感染后数十年才出现传导异常，急诊识别对避免进展为完全性房室传导阻滞和心源性猝死至关重要，但临床易漏诊。

AI.result: 摘要未报告样本量、终点定义及统计结果；患者接受抗寄生虫治疗，因无症状经共同决策暂缓起搏器植入。

summary_zh:
表现：一名30多岁的玻利维亚男性因非劳力性胸痛和间歇性二度房室（2:1）传导阻滞就诊于急诊科。

title: Integration of an echocardiographic motion-management system into photon-based stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation planning
summary: Background and purpose Cardiorespiratory ultrasound motion monitoring may enhance the precision of dose delivery for stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation (STAR) of ventricular tachycardia. This treatment planning study aimed to evaluate the feasibility of photon-based STAR planning in the presence of an ultrasound probe.Materials and methods For sixteen targets in fourteen patients, three treatment plans were retrospectively created and compared: a reference plan without an ultrasound probe and two plans in which the ultrasound probe was spared from the primary treatment beam (apical or parasternal probe positions). Descriptive and statistical analyses were performed for target/organ dose-volume and treatment beam metrics, conformity-indices and maximum probe exposure.Results The ultrasound probe could be spared from the primary beam in all cases with D0.035 cm³ < 1 Gy (median 0.2 Gy with apical and 0.4 Gy with parasternal placement) with slightly elevated organ dose-volume metrics and no significant differences in target dose-volume metrics. The conformity-index (50 % isodose line) differed significantly for apical and parasternal probe position (median reference plan 4.0 vs. 5.0 and 4.5, respectively; p < 0.01). The parasternal position gave slightly superior results compared to the apical position (e.g., heart minus planning target volume V12.5 Gy 7.6 % [4.7-13.3] vs. 8.2 % [6.4-12.5]; left lung V10 Gy 3.4 % [1.0-4.5] vs. 4.2 % [1.6-6.8]), albeit in all plans dose guidance parameters remained within clinically acceptable limits.Conclusions The ultrasound probe could be spared from the primary beam without compromising photon-based STAR plan quality beyond clinically acceptable deviations. The results support further investigation of ultrasound-based STAR motion management.

AI.tldr: 在光子立体定向心律失常放射消融计划中，将超声探头置于主束外（心尖或胸骨旁）可保护探头（D0.035cm³<1Gy），靶区剂量学无显著差异，但适形指数略降，胸骨旁位置略优。
AI.motivation: 呼吸心脏运动监测可提高室性心动过速立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）的剂量递送精度，但超声探头可能干扰光子束，需评估其整合可行性。
AI.method: 治疗计划研究，回顾性分析14例患者16个靶区，为每个靶区制定三种光子STAR计划：无探头参考计划、心尖位探头避让计划、胸骨旁位探头避让计划。比较靶区/器官剂量体积参数、治疗束参数、适形指数及探头最大受量，行描述性与统计分析。
AI.result: 所有计划均实现探头避让，探头D0.035cm³<1 Gy（中位心尖0.2 Gy，胸骨旁0.4 Gy）。靶区剂量体积参数无显著差异，器官剂量体积参数略升高。适形指数（50%等剂量线）在参考计划、心尖位和胸骨旁位分别为中位4.0、5.0和4.5（p<0.01）。胸骨旁位略优于心尖位（如心脏减PTV V12.5Gy：7.6% [4.7-13.3] vs. 8.2% [6.4-12.5]；左肺V10Gy：3.4% [1.0-4.5] vs. 4.2% [1.6-6.8]），但所有计划剂量参数均在临床可接受范围内。
AI.conclusion: 光子STAR计划中可将超声探头置于主束外而不影响计划质量超出临床可接受偏差，支持进一步研究超声运动管理在STAR中的应用；但适形指数略降，需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：心肺超声运动监测可能提高室性心动过速立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）剂量递送的精确性。本治疗计划研究旨在评估在存在超声探头的情况下基于光子的STAR计划的可行性。

材料与方法：针对14例患者的16个靶点，回顾性创建并比较了三个治疗计划：一个无超声探头的参考计划，以及两个将超声探头避离主要治疗束的计划（心尖或胸骨旁探头位置）。对靶点/器官剂量-体积和治疗束指标、适形指数及最大探头暴露进行了描述性和统计分析。

结果：在所有病例中，超声探头均可避离主要束流，D0.035 cm³ < 1 Gy（心尖位置中位数为0.2 Gy，胸骨旁位置为0.4 Gy），器官剂量-体积指标略有升高，靶点剂量-体积指标无显著差异。适形指数（50%等剂量线）在心尖和胸骨旁探头位置存在显著差异（参考计划中位数4.0 vs. 分别为5.0和4.5；p < 0.01）。胸骨旁位置的结果略优于心尖位置（例如，心脏减去计划靶区V12.5 Gy 7.6% [4.7-13.3] vs. 8.2% [6.4-12.5]；左肺V10 Gy 3.4% [1.0-4.5] vs. 4.2% [1.6-6.8]），尽管在所有计划中剂量指导参数均保持在临床可接受范围内。

结论：超声探头可避离主要束流，而不会使基于光子的STAR计划质量超出临床可接受的偏差。结果支持进一步研究基于超声的STAR运动管理。

title: Clinical readiness and methodological rigor of AI models for ventricular arrhythmia and sudden cardiac death prediction: A systematic review with PROBAST+AI appraisal.
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) remains a major cause of mortality, and risk stratification based on left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) has significant limitations. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a potential approach for modeling complex arrhythmic risk. We conducted a systematic review with prespecified anchor subgroup reporting (without pooling) to evaluate the performance of AI models in predicting SCD and malignant ventricular arrhythmias. We searched MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase, and Scopus from inception to 3 October 2025. Anchor subgroup reporting was restricted to studies reporting area under the receiver-operating characteristic curve (AUROC) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) within predefined modality/horizon subgroups. Studies without CIs or relying on cross-validation variance were summarized narratively as supplementary evidence. Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria; five reported AUROC with 95% CIs within prespecified modality/horizon subgroups and were included as anchor subgroup estimates (k=1 per subgroup). Methodological quality and reporting were limited: 54% of studies (7/13) were classified as high risk of bias according to PROBAST+AI, driven by cross-validation-only designs, unit-of-analysis issues, limited external validation, and sparse calibration reporting. Among anchor estimates, deep learning on single-lead ambulatory ECG showed high discrimination for near-term ventricular tachyarrhythmias (AUROC 0.948, 95% CI 0.926-0.967), while 12-lead ECG models achieved good performance for long-term SCD (AUROC 0.820, 95% CI 0.794-0.847). The multimodal anchor estimate (AUROC 0.84) was numerically higher than the CMR radiomics anchor (AUROC 0.70), but this represents an indirect between-study contrast. AI-ECG models show high reported discrimination in near-term risk windows, but cross-study comparisons are indirect, and methodological heterogeneity remains a barrier to translation into clinical practice.

AI.tldr: AI模型预测室性心律失常和心源性猝死呈现较高区分度，但方法学质量有限，54%研究存在高偏倚风险，临床转化受限。
AI.motivation: 心源性猝死是主要死因，基于LVEF的风险分层存在显著局限。人工智能为建模复杂心律失常风险提供了新途径，但既往证据缺乏对模型性能和方法学质量的系统评估。
AI.method: 系统综述，检索MEDLINE/PubMed、Embase和Scopus自建库至2025年10月3日。纳入13项研究，预设锚定亚组报告（不合并），仅纳入报告AUROC及95%CI且属于预设模态/时间窗亚组的研究作为锚定估计（每亚组k=1）。无CI或依赖交叉验证方差的研究作为补充证据叙述性总结。采用PROBAST+AI评估方法学质量和报告质量。
AI.result: 13项研究中，5项提供锚定亚组估计。54%（7/13）研究被PROBAST+AI评为高偏倚风险，原因包括仅交叉验证设计、分析单元问题、外部验证有限和校准报告稀疏。单导联动态心电图深度学习对近期室性快速性心律失常区分度高（AUROC 0.948，95%CI 0.926-0.967）；12导联心电图模型对长期SCD表现良好（AUROC 0.820，95%CI 0.794-0.847）。多模态锚定估计（AUROC 0.84）数值上高于CMR放射组学锚定估计（AUROC 0.70），但为间接的跨研究比较。
AI.conclusion: AI-ECG模型在近期风险窗内报告了高区分度，但跨研究比较为间接，方法学异质性仍是临床转化的障碍。未来需标准化报告、外部验证和校准评估以推动临床应用。

title: Correction to: Electrocardiogram Signal Classification for Diagnosis Sudden Cardiac Death Using 2D CNN and LSTM
summary: I have found an error in the data preparation of the original article. The error invalidates its reported results, including the headline 2D-CNN accuracy of 96.67 % (1-, 2- and 3-minute images, reported in the abstract and the 2D-CNN results table), every other accuracy in its three results tables, and its conclusions. Readers should not cite the article as evidence that ECG images can diagnose or predict sudden cardiac death (SCD).
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.motivation: 原文声称利用2D-CNN与LSTM对心电图信号分类可诊断或预测心脏性猝死（SCD），此类高准确率结果可能影响临床对AI辅助SCD筛查的判断，但作者在复核中发现数据准备环节存在错误，需公开更正以纠正既往证据。
AI.method: 本文为更正声明，非原始研究。作者指出原论文在数据准备阶段存在错误，该错误使原文报告的结果失效，涉及摘要与2D-CNN结果表中1、2、3分钟图像的96.67%准确率、三张结果表中的其他所有准确率以及原文结论；摘要未报告样本量、研究人群、终点定义及统计方法。

AI.conclusion: 原文不能作为心电图图像可诊断或预测SCD的证据，临床与科研引用时应予剔除；该事件提示基于ECG图像的深度学习研究需严格核查数据准备与划分流程，但本声明未提供错误细节与可替代的验证结果，相关AI筛查SCD的临床价值仍待规范研究证实。

title: The Regionalization of High-Volume Cardiac Pacing: A Prospective Cohort Study on Safety, Feasibility, and the Learning Curve in a Geriatric Population.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Centralizing pacemaker implantations delays care for geriatric populations in remote regions, particularly in post-Soviet healthcare systems like Latvia. We hypothesized that a regional hospital could safely establish a high-volume pacing program to overcome geographical barriers, utilizing structured mentorship from a national tertiary center.

METHODS: This 2-year prospective observational study evaluated 173 consecutive patients (mean age 78.1 years) undergoing permanent pacemaker implantation at Daugavpils Regional Hospital. Procedures were performed by two regional interventional cardiologists transitioning to independent practice, supported by Latvian Cardiology Centre mentors. Endpoints included 30-day major complications, procedural efficiency, surgical learning curve evaluation using Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) analysis, and patient-reported quality of life (AQUAREL, SF-36).

RESULTS: Across 173 procedures (66.5% dual-chamber, 33.5% single-chamber), the overall complication rate was 5.7%. CUSUM analysis demonstrated a complication rate reduction from 8.7% during the initial acquisition phase to a 3.4% expertise plateau. Procedural efficiency stabilized with a mean fluoroscopy time of 3.9 min. Specific complications included lead dislodgement (2.3%), pocket hematoma (1.7%), pneumothorax (1.1%), and wound infection (0.6%), managed successfully without mortality or device abandonment. At 6-month follow-up, patients reported significant quality of life improvements and high trust in the regional team.

CONCLUSIONS: Regional high-volume cardiac pacing programs are safe and vital for equitable geriatric care. With structured mentorship, regional hospitals can overcome historical centralization, safely transitioning to independent high-volume centers and achieving an expert-level safety profile non-inferior to tertiary standards.

AI.tldr: 在拉脱维亚地区医院，经结构化导师指导，高容量起搏器植入项目安全可行，学习曲线显示并发症率从8.7%降至3.4%，无死亡。
AI.motivation: 中心化起搏器植入导致偏远地区老年患者治疗延迟，尤其在拉脱维亚等后苏联医疗体系中；既往缺乏区域医院建立高容量起搏项目安全性和学习曲线的证据。
AI.method: 2年前瞻性观察研究，纳入Daugavpils地区医院连续173例永久起搏器植入患者（平均年龄78.1岁），由两名区域介入心脏病学家在拉脱维亚心脏病中心导师支持下操作；终点包括30天主要并发症、手术效率、CUSUM分析学习曲线及患者报告生活质量（AQUAREL、SF-36）。
AI.result: 总体并发症率5.7%；CUSUM分析显示并发症率从初始学习阶段8.7%降至熟练平台期3.4%；平均透视时间3.9分钟；具体并发症：导线脱位2.3%、囊袋血肿1.7%、气胸1.1%、伤口感染0.6%，均成功处理，无死亡或设备废弃；6个月随访生活质量显著改善，患者对区域团队信任度高。
AI.conclusion: 区域高容量心脏起搏项目安全且对老年公平医疗至关重要；结构化导师指导下，区域医院可安全过渡为独立高容量中心，达到不劣于三级医院的安全水平；但需注意单中心观察性研究的局限性。

summary_zh:
背景：集中化起搏器植入延迟了偏远地区老年人群的医疗照护，尤其是在拉脱维亚等后苏联医疗体系中。我们假设一家地区医院能够安全地建立高容量起搏项目以克服地理障碍，并利用来自国家三级中心的结构化指导。

方法：这项为期2年的前瞻性观察性研究评估了在Daugavpils地区医院接受永久起搏器植入的173例连续患者（平均年龄78.1岁）。手术由两名正在过渡到独立执业的地区介入心脏病学家在拉脱维亚心脏病学中心导师的支持下完成。终点包括30天主要并发症、手术效率、使用累积和（CUSUM）分析评估的手术学习曲线以及患者报告的生活质量（AQUAREL、SF-36）。

结果：在173例手术中（66.5%双腔，33.5%单腔），总体并发症率为5.7%。CUSUM分析显示并发症率从初始学习阶段的8.7%降至熟练平台期的3.4%。手术效率稳定，平均透视时间为3.9分钟。具体并发症包括导线脱位（2.3%）、囊袋血肿（1.7%）、气胸（1.1%）和伤口感染（0.6%），均成功处理，无死亡或设备废弃。在6个月随访时，患者报告生活质量显著改善并对地区团队高度信任。

title: Subcutaneous and Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Clinical Framework for Breast Surgery, Pregnancy, Lactation, Radiation Therapy, and Breast Imaging.
summary: The subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator and extravascular implantable cardioverter-defibrillator do not require intravascular, intracardiac, or epicardial leads, making them attractive alternatives to transvenous implantable cardioverter defibrillators in patients without bradycardia pacing or cardiac resynchronization therapy indications. These systems are especially useful for patients with venous access challenges and those at risk for endovascular infections, including patients with renal failure or those who are immunocompromised. Women with prior or anticipated breast surgery, such as mastectomy or breast reconstruction surgery, or those who are lactating present unique anatomic, procedural, and post-operative quality-of-life considerations. This commentary provides a practical, scenario-based framework for managing this unique patient group. Key considerations include individualized incision and pulse generator planning, proactive multidisciplinary coordination, procedure-specific management, and shared decision-making in patients with prior or anticipated breast augmentation or reduction, pregnancy, lactation, mastectomy, radiation therapy, and breast imaging.

title: Leadless pacemaker in atrioventricular block patients with specific indications: a systematic review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Leadless cardiac pacemakers are becoming a viable alternative to traditional intravenous pacemakers. This study aims to systematically evaluate the safety of using leadless pacemakers in patients with atrioventricular block (AVB) who meet specific indications, based on existing published research.

METHODS: A comprehensive literature search was conducted in PubMed, Web of Science, CNKI, Embase, Cochrane Library, ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (ICTRP) and Wanfang Database for clinical studies on leadless pacemaker treatment for atrioventricular block. Data analysis was conducted using RevMan and R software. Relative risk (RR) with 95% confidence interval (CI) was calculated. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I2 statistic.

RESULTS: A total of 60 studies were ultimately included, with AVB patients accounting for 6% to 100% of the implanted population. The overall incidence of adverse events in patients receiving leadless pacemakers was low. Among these, 16 studies provided complication data for the AVB subgroup and were included in the meta-analysis. The results showed that, compared with the control group, leadless pacemakers did not significantly reduce the risk of adverse events in AVB patients (RR = 1.41, 95% CI: 0.43-4.60, P = 0.57). Subgroup analysis by device type demonstrated no statistically significant differences in adverse event risks compared to traditional pacemakers for either single-chamber ventricular leadless pacemakers (RR = 0.26, 95% CI: 0.03-2.01, P = 0.20) or AV-synchronous/dual-chamber leadless pacemakers (RR = 2.16, 95% CI: 0.76-6.17, P = 0.15), with no significant interaction between subgroups. In the single-arm rate analysis, five cohort studies reported an adverse event rate of 14% (95% CI: 0.04-0.24); after applying the Freeman-Tukey transformation to eleven single-arm studies, the adverse event rate was 1.15% (95% CI: 0.26%-2.67%).

CONCLUSION: In patients with atrioventricular block, leadless pacemakers demonstrate no significant difference in the risk of adverse events compared with conventional pacemakers, with lower complication rates and favorable clinical feasibility.

AI.tldr: 在房室传导阻滞患者中，无导线起搏器与传统起搏器的不良事件风险无显著差异（RR=1.41，95%CI 0.43-4.60），单臂汇总并发症率较低。
AI.motivation: 无导线起搏器正成为传统经静脉起搏器的替代选择，但其在房室传导阻滞（AVB）这一特定人群中的安全性证据尚缺乏系统评价，本研究旨在基于已发表研究系统评估该人群使用无导线起搏器的安全性。
AI.method: 系统评价与荟萃分析。检索 PubMed、Web of Science、CNKI、Embase、Cochrane Library、ClinicalTrials.gov、WHO ICTRP 及万方数据库，纳入无导线起搏器治疗 AVB 的临床研究；采用 RevMan 与 R 软件分析，计算相对危险度（RR）及 95%CI，以 I2 统计量评估异质性。共纳入 60 项研究，其中 16 项提供 AVB 亚组并发症数据进入荟萃分析；另对单臂研究进行发生率分析。
AI.result: AVB 患者占植入人群的 6%~100%，总体不良事件发生率低。荟萃分析显示，与对照组相比，无导线起搏器未显著降低 AVB 患者不良事件风险（RR=1.41，95%CI 0.43-4.60，P=0.57）。按器械类型亚组分析：单腔心室无导线起搏器 RR=0.26（95%CI 0.03-2.01，P=0.20），房室同步/双腔无导线起搏器 RR=2.16（95%CI 0.76-6.17，P=0.15），亚组间无显著交互作用。单臂分析中，5 项队列研究报告不良事件率为 14%（95%CI 0.04-0.24）；对 11 项单臂研究行 Freeman-Tukey 转换后，不良事件率为 1.15%（95%CI 0.26%-2.67%）。
AI.conclusion: 在 AVB 患者中，无导线起搏器与传统起搏器的不良事件风险无显著差异，且并发症率较低、临床可行性良好。这支持无导线起搏器作为 AVB 特定适应证患者的可选方案；但纳入研究以单臂和小样本为主、对照组设置与事件定义异质性较大，结论需更大规模随机对照研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：无导线心脏起搏器正逐渐成为传统经静脉起搏器的可行替代方案。本研究旨在基于现有已发表的研究，系统评价在符合特定适应证的房室传导阻滞（AVB）患者中使用无导线起搏器的安全性。

方法：在PubMed、Web of Science、CNKI、Embase、Cochrane Library、ClinicalTrials.gov、WHO国际临床试验注册平台（ICTRP）和万方数据库中进行全面文献检索，检索关于无导线起搏器治疗房室传导阻滞的临床研究。使用RevMan和R软件进行数据分析。计算相对危险度（RR）及其95%置信区间（CI）。采用I2统计量评估异质性。

结果：最终共纳入60项研究，AVB患者在植入人群中占6%至100%。接受无导线起搏器治疗的患者总体不良事件发生率较低。其中，16项研究提供了AVB亚组的并发症数据并被纳入meta分析。结果显示，与对照组相比，无导线起搏器并未显著降低AVB患者的不良事件风险（RR = 1.41，95% CI：0.43-4.60，P = 0.57）。按器械类型进行亚组分析显示，无论是单腔心室无导线起搏器（RR = 0.26，95% CI：0.03-2.01，P = 0.20）还是房室同步/双腔无导线起搏器（RR = 2.16，95% CI：0.76-6.17，P = 0.15），与传统起搏器相比，不良事件风险均无统计学显著差异，且亚组间无显著交互作用。在单臂率分析中，五项队列研究报告的不良事件率为14%（95% CI：0.04-0.24）；对十一项单臂研究应用Freeman-Tukey变换后，不良事件率为1.15%（95% CI：0.26%-2.67%）。

结论：在房室传导阻滞患者中，与常规起搏器相比，无导线起搏器的不良事件风险无显著差异，并发症发生率较低，临床可行性良好。

title: Atrial leadless pacemaker implantation in the setting of an active infection.
Leadless Atrial Pacemaker Implantation at a Nonstandard Site After Unsuccessful Conventional Atrial Placement.
summary: After unsuccessful implantation at the conventional right atrial appendage site, an atrial leadless pacemaker was implanted at the high right atrial septum. Electrical parameters were maintained during 6-month follow-up.

AI.tldr: 常规右心耳起搏失败后，将心房无导线起搏器改植于高位右房间隔，6个月随访电学参数稳定。

AI.method: 病例报告（单例）。患者经常规右心耳部位心房无导线起搏器植入失败后，改在高位右房间隔植入，随访6个月观察起搏电学参数。摘要未报告患者基线特征、具体电学参数数值及统计方法。

AI.conclusion: 提示高位右房间隔可作为常规右心耳植入失败时心房无导线起搏器的备选部位，短期电学表现稳定；但仅为单例病例报告，样本量小、随访仅6个月，结论需更大样本与更长随访验证。

title: 5G Cloud-Enabled Telemedicine for Remote Management of Heart Failure Patients With Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Multicenter Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: Postoperative follow-up for patients with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators and cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillators (ICD/CRT-D) is often delayed in remote areas because of geographic barriers and limited healthcare resources, increasing the risk of adverse outcomes. The "Make Changes" study, was a prospective, multicenter, open-label randomized trial evaluating a 5G-cloud technology platform (5G-CTP) for real-time remote device interrogation and reprogramming versus standard In-clinic care. Between October 2022 and February 2024, 206 patients from five centers were randomly assigned to 12 months of follow-up with 5G-CTP (n = 104) or In-clinic care (n = 102). For the primary endpoint of time from clinical event to intervention, the 5G-CTP group had a significantly shorter response time than the In-Clinic group (4.2 vs. 11.5 days; p < 0.001). For secondary endpoints, the 5G-CTP group showed greater improvement in life quality at 12 months based on Minnesota Living with Heart Failure Questionnaire (p = 0.012). Rates of unplanned visits and clinical interventions were similar between groups, with no procedure-related complications. This model integrates community hospitals with implantation centers through 5G networks, enabling timely specialist-directed care locally without long-distance travel. It is a feasible strategy for postoperative ICD/CRT-D management, particularly in underserved regions with limited access to specialized cardiac care.

AI.tldr: 5G云远程管理ICD/CRT-D患者可显著缩短临床事件至干预时间（4.2 vs 11.5天，P<0.001），并改善12个月生活质量。
AI.motivation: 偏远地区ICD/CRT-D患者术后随访因地理障碍和医疗资源有限常延迟，增加不良结局风险，亟需远程管理策略。
AI.method: 前瞻性、多中心、开放标签随机对照试验，纳入5中心206例ICD/CRT-D患者，随机分为5G云技术平台（5G-CTP）组（n=104）和门诊随访组（n=102），随访12个月。主要终点为临床事件至干预时间；次要终点包括生活质量（明尼苏达心衰生活质量问卷）等。
AI.result: 5G-CTP组主要终点响应时间显著短于门诊组（4.2 vs 11.5天，P<0.001）。12个月生活质量改善更显著（P=0.012）。非计划就诊率和临床干预率两组相似，无操作相关并发症。
AI.conclusion: 5G云远程管理模型通过连接社区医院与植入中心，实现本地专科指导，是ICD/CRT-D术后管理的可行策略，尤其适合医疗资源匮乏地区；但需注意开放标签设计的局限性。

summary_zh: 对于植入式心律转复除颤器和心脏再同步治疗除颤器（ICD/CRT-D）患者的术后随访，在偏远地区常因地理障碍和医疗资源有限而延迟，增加了不良结局的风险。"Make Changes"研究是一项前瞻性、多中心、开放标签随机试验，评估了5G云技术平台（5G-CTP）用于实时远程设备询问和重编程与标准门诊护理的比较。2022年10月至2024年2月期间，来自五个中心的206例患者被随机分配至接受12个月5G-CTP随访（n = 104）或门诊护理（n = 102）。对于主要终点，即从临床事件到干预的时间，5G-CTP组的响应时间显著短于门诊组（4.2 vs. 11.5天；p < 0.001）。对于次要终点，基于明尼苏达心力衰竭生活质量问卷，5G-CTP组在12个月时生活质量改善更大（p = 0.012）。两组计划外就诊和临床干预的发生率相似，无操作相关并发症。该模式通过5G网络将社区医院与植入中心整合，使患者无需长途旅行即可在当地获得及时的专科医生指导护理。这是ICD/CRT-D术后管理的一种可行策略，特别是在获得专科心脏护理机会有限的欠发达地区。

title: A compartmentalized SCN model explains temperature resistance through interregional phase differences.
summary: Temperature cycles entrain circadian rhythms in many peripheral tissues, yet the master circadian pacemaker (suprachiasmatic nucleus) in mammals remains largely insensitive to the same input. Despite their similar molecular circuitry, the mechanisms underlying the distinct temperature responses of central and peripheral clocks remain unclear. To address this, we developed a compartmentalized model of the SCN circadian clock that integrates the heat shock protein (HSP) pathway, simulating the response of the SCN network to temperature variations. Using this model, we successfully recapitulated key experimental observations, including the ability of heat stimuli to entrain peripheral clocks to an inverted phase while the SCN maintains its resistance. Further analysis reveals that intrinsic phase heterogeneity among SCN subregions underlies this entrainment resistance. Specifically, the phase difference between the dorsal and ventral SCN leads to divergent phase responses upon simultaneous stimulation, resulting in an attenuated net shift of the overall SCN phase. Moreover, the mode of thermal input, in which the dorsal and ventral regions are stimulated concurrently, may further enhance the SCN's robustness to temperature entrainment. These results suggest that the SCN's resistance to temperature entrainment may differ mechanistically from photic entrainment, and highlight the potential importance of its spatial structure in maintaining circadian stability.

AI.tldr: 分区化SCN模型显示，背侧与腹侧SCN亚区间的内在相位异质性使整体相位净位移衰减，从而解释视交叉上核抵抗温度重置而外周钟可被温度倒相重置。
AI.motivation: 哺乳动物视交叉上核作为主生物钟对温度周期基本不敏感，而外周组织钟可被温度周期重置；两者分子环路相似，中枢与外周温度反应差异的机制不明，既往模型多未纳入热休克蛋白通路及SCN空间结构。
AI.method: 计算建模研究，构建整合热休克蛋白通路的SCN昼夜节律分区化模型，模拟SCN网络对温度变化的反应，并与既往温度重置外周钟、SCN抵抗的实验观察进行比对；进一步分析SCN亚区间相位异质性及热输入模式对整体相位位移的影响。属模型仿真研究，样本量与统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 模型成功重现关键实验现象：热刺激可使外周钟倒相重置，而SCN保持抵抗。机制分析显示，背侧与腹侧SCN间的相位差使同步刺激下两亚区相位反应方向分歧，导致整体SCN相位净位移衰减；背腹同时受热刺激的输入模式进一步增强SCN对温度重置的稳健性。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: SCN对温度重置的抵抗可能不同于光性重置机制，其空间结构（背腹相位异质性）对维持昼夜节律稳定性具有潜在重要作用；该模型为理解中枢钟稳健性提供计算框架，但结论基于仿真，尚需实验验证，且缺乏定量效应估计。

summary_zh: 温度周期能够同步许多外周组织的昼夜节律，然而哺乳动物的主昼夜节律起搏器（视交叉上核）对相同的输入在很大程度上仍不敏感。尽管中枢与外周时钟的分子环路相似，但其温度反应差异背后的机制仍不清楚。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个整合热休克蛋白（HSP）通路的视交叉上核昼夜节律时钟区室化模型，模拟视交叉上核网络对温度变化的反应。利用该模型，我们成功重现了关键的实验观察结果，包括热刺激能够将外周时钟同步至倒转相位，而视交叉上核保持其抵抗性。进一步分析揭示，视交叉上核亚区之间的内在相位异质性是该同步抵抗性的基础。具体而言，背侧与腹侧视交叉上核之间的相位差导致同时刺激时出现不同的相位反应，从而使视交叉上核整体相位的净偏移减弱。此外，热输入模式——即背侧与腹侧区域同时受到刺激——可能进一步增强视交叉上核对温度同步的稳健性。这些结果提示，视交叉上核对温度同步的抵抗性在机制上可能不同于光同步，并突显了其空间结构在维持昼夜节律稳定性中的潜在重要性。

title: Lead-to-Vein Ratio and Long-Term Vascular Safety After Transvenous Pacing in Children Weighing ≤15 Kg.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Transvenous pacing in low-weight children is technically feasible, but its clinical use depends on long-term venous patency, system performance, and ventricular function. We aimed to describe imaging-defined venous abnormalities and clinically overt vascular events after first transvenous pacemaker implantation and to explore whether the lead-to-vein ratio provides anatomical information beyond body weight.

METHODS: This prospective observational cohort included 35 children weighing ≤15 kg undergoing first transvenous pacemaker implantation between 2010 and 2020. The primary vascular endpoint was imaging-defined venous thrombosis, occlusion, or stenosis ≥50%; clinical impact was recorded separately. Device-related safety, minimum venous diameter, lead-to-vein ratio, ventricular function, synchrony, and paced QRS duration were analyzed using non-parametric, exact, and exploratory univariable tests.

RESULTS: Median follow-up was 6.7 [4.5-8.2] years. Eleven patients weighed <10 kg and 3 weighed <5 kg. The imaging-defined vascular endpoint occurred in 6/35 patients; 5 were asymptomatic surveillance findings and 1 was clinically symptomatic. The lead-to-vein ratio was higher in patients with the endpoint than in those without events (0.59 [0.55-0.63] vs. 0.47 [0.43-0.51]; p = 0.003). A ratio >0.55 was associated with more frequent imaging-defined endpoints (4/8 vs. 2/27; odds ratio 12.5; 95% confidence interval 1.7-92.3). Left ventricular ejection fraction remained preserved.

CONCLUSION: During the first transvenous system lifespan, imaging-defined venous abnormalities were relatively frequent but mostly asymptomatic, whereas clinically overt vascular complications were uncommon. The lead-to-vein ratio may support anatomical pre-implant risk stratification, although multicenter validation and follow-up beyond generator replacement are required.

AI.tldr: 在体重≤15 kg儿童中，经静脉起搏后影像学静脉异常发生率为17%，多无症状，导线-静脉比值>0.55与风险增加相关。
AI.motivation: 低体重儿童经静脉起搏技术可行，但长期静脉通畅性、系统性能和心室功能数据有限，且体重是否足以进行解剖风险分层尚不明确。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察队列，纳入2010-2020年35例体重≤15 kg首次经静脉起搏器植入患儿。主要血管终点为影像学定义的静脉血栓、闭塞或狭窄≥50%，临床影响单独记录。分析器械安全性、最小静脉直径、导线-静脉比值、心室功能、同步性及起搏QRS时限，采用非参数、精确和探索性单变量检验。
AI.result: 中位随访6.7年。11例体重<10 kg，3例<5 kg。6/35例发生影像学血管终点，其中5例为无症状监测发现，1例有临床症状。有终点者导线-静脉比值更高（0.59 vs 0.47，p=0.003）。比值>0.55与影像学终点更频繁相关（4/8 vs 2/27；OR 12.5，95%CI 1.7-92.3）。左心室射血分数保持正常。
AI.conclusion: 首次经静脉系统寿命期内，影像学静脉异常较常见但多无症状，临床显性血管并发症少见。导线-静脉比值可能辅助术前解剖风险分层，但需多中心验证及超越起搏器更换的长期随访。

summary_zh:
背景：低体重儿童经静脉起搏在技术上是可行的，但其临床应用取决于长期静脉通畅性、系统性能和心室功能。我们旨在描述首次经静脉起搏器植入后影像学定义的静脉异常和临床明显的血管事件，并探讨导线-静脉比值是否能提供超越体重的解剖学信息。

方法：这项前瞻性观察性队列研究纳入了2010年至2020年间接受首次经静脉起搏器植入的35名体重≤15 kg的儿童。主要血管终点为影像学定义的静脉血栓形成、闭塞或狭窄≥50%；临床影响单独记录。器械相关安全性、最小静脉直径、导线-静脉比值、心室功能、同步性及起搏QRS时限采用非参数、精确及探索性单变量检验进行分析。

结果：中位随访时间为6.7 [4.5-8.2]年。11名患者体重<10 kg，3名体重<5 kg。影像学定义的血管终点发生于6/35名患者；其中5例为无症状监测发现，1例有临床症状。发生终点的患者导线-静脉比值高于无事件患者（0.59 [0.55-0.63] vs. 0.47 [0.43-0.51]；p = 0.003）。比值>0.55与更频繁的影像学定义终点相关（4/8 vs. 2/27；比值比12.5；95%置信区间1.7-92.3）。左心室射血分数保持正常。

结论：在首个经静脉系统使用寿命期间，影像学定义的静脉异常相对常见但多无症状，而临床明显的血管并发症不常见。导线-静脉比值可能有助于植入前解剖学风险分层，但仍需多中心验证及超越起搏器更换后的随访。

title: Conduction system pacing versus biventricular pacing for cardiac resynchronization therapy: an updated systematic review and meta‑analysis
summary: Abstract Background Conduction system pacing (CSP) has emerged as a potential alternative to biventricular pacing (BiVP) for cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT). However, the relative efficacy and safety of different CSP techniques remain unclear. Methods We searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and Web of Science for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing CSP with BiVP. Primary outcome: composite of all‑cause death or heart failure hospitalization. Secondary outcomes: change in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), change in left ventricular end‑systolic volume (LVESV), echocardiographic response (structural: LVESV reduction ≥ 15%; functional: LVEF increase ≥ 5%), QRS duration shortening, NYHA functional class improvement, and complication rate. Random‑effects meta‑analysis was used, with four pre‑specified subgroups: CSP with optimization, strict left bundle branch pacing (LBBP), His‑CRT, and left ventricular septal pacing (LVSP)‑dominant. Results Ten independent RCTs (Vinther 2021/Frandsen 2026 counted as one trial) were included, CSP significantly reduced the risk of all‑cause death or heart failure hospitalization (risk ratio RR 0.47, 95% CI 0.32–0.69, P < 0.0001 ; no subgroup interaction, P = 0.35), Overall LVEF change did not differ (MD 2.03%, 95% CI − 0.34% to 4.39%, P = 0.09, I² = 80%), but subgroup differences were significant ( P = 0.03): strict LBBP (MD 5.55%) and His‑CRT (MD 3.12%) favored CSP. Overall LVESV change showed a non‑significant trend (MD − 6.97 mL, 95% CI − 14.30 to 0.36 mL, P = 0.06, I² = 64%); strict LBBP significantly reduced LVESV (MD − 23.98 mL). Functional response favored CSP (RR 1.10, 95% CI 1.00–1.20, P = 0.05, I² = 0%), but structural response did not (RR 1.04, 95% CI 0.90–1.20, P = 0.57). CSP significantly shortened QRS duration (MD − 8.88 ms, 95% CI − 15.32 to − 2.45 ms, P = 0.007, I² = 87%), driven by the CSP‑with‑optimization subgroup (I² = 0%). NYHA class improvement favored CSP (MD − 0.21, 95% CI − 0.33 to − 0.09, P = 0.0007). Overall complication rates did not differ (RR 0.93, 95% CI 0.55–1.58, P = 0.79), but the His‑CRT subgroup had a higher risk in the long‑term Frandsen 2026 study (RR 4.00). Meta‑regression showed that each 10‑ms increase in baseline QRS duration was associated with a 4.09% reduction in LVEF benefit of CSP over BiVP ( P = 0.04). CSP technique significantly explained heterogeneity in LVEF ( P = 0.004) and LVESV ( P = 0.0003), with strict LBBP reducing LVESV by 23.98 mL more than His‑CRT. Conclusions CSP significantly reduces all‑cause death or heart failure hospitalization, improves electrical synchrony and functional class, but LVEF and LVESV improvements are seen only in specific subgroups. Significant differences in efficacy and safety exist among CSP techniques, supporting individualized CRT strategies based on technical characteristics and patient condition.

AI.tldr: 在CRT中，CSP较BiVP显著降低全因死亡或心衰住院风险（RR 0.47），改善QRS时限和NYHA分级，但LVEF和LVESV改善仅见于特定亚组（严格LBBP和His-CRT）。
AI.motivation: CSP作为CRT的潜在替代方案，其不同技术（优化CSP、严格LBBP、His-CRT、LVSP主导）的相对疗效和安全性尚不明确，需要更新系统评价和荟萃分析。
AI.method: 系统检索PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library和Web of Science的RCT，比较CSP与BiVP。主要终点为全因死亡或心衰住院复合终点；次要终点包括LVEF变化、LVESV变化、超声反应（结构：LVESV降低≥15%；功能：LVEF增加≥5%）、QRS缩短、NYHA改善和并发症。采用随机效应荟萃分析，预设四个亚组：优化CSP、严格LBBP、His-CRT和LVSP主导。
AI.result: 纳入10项RCT。CSP显著降低全因死亡或心衰住院风险（RR 0.47，95%CI 0.32-0.69，P<0.0001；亚组交互P=0.35）。总体LVEF变化无差异（MD 2.03%，95%CI -0.34%至4.39%，P=0.09，I²=80%），但亚组差异显著（P=0.03）：严格LBBP（MD 5.55%）和His-CRT（MD 3.12%）利于CSP。LVESV变化呈非显著趋势（MD -6.97 mL，95%CI -14.30至0.36 mL，P=0.06，I²=64%）；严格LBBP显著降低LVESV（MD -23.98 mL）。功能反应利于CSP（RR 1.10，95%CI 1.00-1.20，P=0.05，I²=0%），结构反应无差异（RR 1.04，95%CI 0.90-1.20，P=0.57）。CSP显著缩短QRS（MD -8.88 ms，95%CI -15.32至-2.45 ms，P=0.007，I²=87%），由优化CSP亚组驱动（I²=0%）。NYHA改善利于CSP（MD -0.21，95%CI -0.33至-0.09，P=0.0007）。总体并发症无差异（RR 0.93，95%CI 0.55-1.58，P=0.79），但His-CRT亚组在长期Frandsen 2026研究中风险较高（RR 4.00）。Meta回归显示基线QRS每增加10 ms，CSP较BiVP的LVEF获益减少4.09%（P=0.04）。CSP技术显著解释LVEF（P=0.004）和LVESV（P=0.0003）的异质性，严格LBBP较His-CRT多降低LVESV 23.98 mL。
AI.conclusion: CSP显著降低全因死亡或心衰住院风险，改善电同步和功能分级，但LVEF和LVESV改善仅见于特定亚组。不同CSP技术在疗效和安全性上存在显著差异，支持基于技术特点和患者状况的个体化CRT策略。

summary_zh:
摘要

背景：传导系统起搏（CSP）已成为心脏再同步治疗（CRT）中双心室起搏（BiVP）的潜在替代方案。然而，不同CSP技术的相对疗效和安全性仍不明确。

方法：我们检索了PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library和Web of Science，寻找比较CSP与BiVP的随机对照试验（RCT）。主要结局：全因死亡或心力衰竭住院的复合终点。次要结局：左心室射血分数（LVEF）变化、左心室收缩末期容积（LVESV）变化、超声心动图反应（结构反应：LVESV降低≥15%；功能反应：LVEF增加≥5%）、QRS时限缩短、NYHA功能分级改善以及并发症发生率。采用随机效应荟萃分析，并预设四个亚组：CSP联合优化、严格左束支起搏（LBBP）、His-CRT和左心室间隔起搏（LVSP）主导。

结果：共纳入10项独立RCT（Vinther 2021/Frandsen 2026计为一项试验），CSP显著降低全因死亡或心力衰竭住院风险（风险比RR 0.47，95% CI 0.32–0.69，P < 0.0001；无亚组交互作用，P = 0.35）。总体LVEF变化无差异（MD 2.03%，95% CI −0.34%至4.39%，P = 0.09，I² = 80%），但亚组差异显著（P = 0.03）：严格LBBP（MD 5.55%）和His-CRT（MD 3.12%）倾向于CSP。总体LVESV变化呈非显著趋势（MD −6.97 mL，95% CI −14.30至0.36 mL，P = 0.06，I² = 64%）；严格LBBP显著降低LVESV（MD −23.98 mL）。功能反应倾向于CSP（RR 1.10，95% CI 1.00–1.20，P = 0.05，I² = 0%），但结构反应无差异（RR 1.04，95% CI 0.90–1.20，P = 0.57）。CSP显著缩短QRS时限（MD −8.88 ms，95% CI −15.32至−2.45 ms，P = 0.007，I² = 87%），由CSP联合优化亚组驱动（I² = 0%）。NYHA分级改善倾向于CSP（MD −0.21，95% CI −0.33至−0.09，P = 0.0007）。总体并发症发生率无差异（RR 0.93，95% CI 0.55–1.58，P = 0.79），但His-CRT亚组在长期Frandsen 2026研究中风险较高（RR 4.00）。荟萃回归显示，基线QRS时限每增加10 ms，CSP相较于BiVP的LVEF获益减少4.09%（P = 0.04）。CSP技术显著解释了LVEF（P = 0.004）和LVESV（P = 0.0003）的异质性，严格LBBP较His-CRT额外降低LVESV 23.98 mL。

结论：CSP显著降低全因死亡或心力衰竭住院风险，改善电同步性和功能分级，但LVEF和LVESV的改善仅见于特定亚组。不同CSP技术在疗效和安全性上存在显著差异，支持基于技术特点和患者状况的个体化CRT策略。

title: Incremental Value of 24-Hour Ambulatory Electrocardiogram–Derived Heart Rate Variability in Machine-Learning Prognostic Models for Heart Failure
summary: To determine whether heart rate variability (HRV) indices derived from 24-hour ambulatory electrocardiography provide complementary prognostic information in machine-learning prognostic models using conventional clinical variables in patients with heart failure, particularly with regard to calibration and threshold-based performance.We analyzed 353 patients with heart failure. The primary endpoint was cardiovascular death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure. Patients were randomly divided into training and test cohorts in a 3:2 ratio. Two gradient boosting models were developed: one using clinical variables and HRV indices, and the other incorporating clinical variables only. To ensure a fair comparison and limit model complexity, the number of selected predictors was restricted to five in both models.The primary endpoint occurred in 49 patients (14%) during a median follow-up of 740 days (interquartile range 566-870 days). In the independent test cohort (n = 141), discrimination (AUC) was similar between the two models (0.77 versus 0.71; DeLong P = 0.263). However, the HRV model showed higher threshold-based classification performance (higher F1 score and accuracy) and a calibration slope closer to 1.0 (slope 1.01 versus 0.73).In machine-learning-based prognostic modeling for heart failure, Holter-derived HRV indices may be associated with clinically relevant classification performance and a calibration slope closer to 1.0, although the improvement in discrimination as assessed by AUC was not statistically significant. These findings suggest that heart rate variability may provide complementary prognostic information not fully captured by standard clinical variables alone.

AI.tldr: 在353例心衰患者中，基于24小时动态心电图的心率变异性指标加入机器学习预后模型后，AUC未显著提高，但阈值分类性能与校准斜率更优。
AI.motivation: 心衰预后评估主要依赖常规临床变量，既往风险模型区分度有限且校准欠佳；24小时动态心电图来源的心率变异性（HRV）指标能否在机器学习模型中提供互补预后信息，尤其是对校准与阈值分类性能的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列，纳入353例心衰患者，主要终点为心血管死亡或心衰恶化住院。按3:2随机分为训练集与测试集，分别构建两个梯度提升模型：一个纳入临床变量联合HRV指标，另一个仅用临床变量；为公平比较并控制复杂度，两模型均限制为5个预测因子。以AUC（DeLong检验）、F1分数、准确率及校准斜率评价性能。
AI.result: 中位随访740天（IQR 566-870天）期间49例（14%）发生主要终点。独立测试集（n=141）中两模型AUC相近（0.77 vs 0.71，DeLong P=0.263）；但HRV模型阈值分类性能更佳（F1分数与准确率更高），校准斜率更接近1.0（1.01 vs 0.73）。
AI.conclusion: 在机器学习心衰预后模型中，动态心电图HRV指标虽未显著改善AUC区分度，但可提升阈值分类表现并改善校准，提示其可提供常规临床变量未完全涵盖的互补预后信息；本研究样本量较小、单中心、事件数有限，结论需外部验证。

summary_zh:
目的：确定在心力衰竭患者中，基于24小时动态心电图的心率变异性（HRV）指标是否能为使用常规临床变量的机器学习预后模型提供补充预后信息，特别是在校准和基于阈值的性能方面。

方法：我们分析了353例心力衰竭患者。主要终点是心血管死亡或因心力衰竭恶化住院。患者按3：2的比例随机分为训练队列和测试队列。开发了两种梯度提升模型：一种使用临床变量和HRV指标，另一种仅纳入临床变量。为确保公平比较并限制模型复杂性，两个模型中选定的预测变量数量均限制为五个。

结果：在中位随访740天（四分位距566-870天）期间，49例患者（14%）发生了主要终点事件。在独立测试队列（n = 141）中，两种模型的区分度（AUC）相似（0.77 vs 0.71；DeLong P = 0.263）。然而，HRV模型显示出更高的基于阈值的分类性能（更高的F1分数和准确率）以及更接近1.0的校准斜率（斜率1.01 vs 0.73）。

结论：在基于机器学习的心力衰竭预后建模中，Holter衍生的HRV指标可能与临床相关的分类性能和更接近1.0的校准斜率相关，尽管通过AUC评估的区分度改善无统计学显著性。这些发现表明，心率变异性可能提供标准临床变量单独无法完全捕捉的补充预后信息。

title: Challenges in Identifying Heart Failure Diagnoses from the Electronic Health Record.
summary:
BACKGROUND: To leverage the EHR effectively for clinical operations, quality improvement, and research, patients with a specific clinical condition such as heart failure are often identified through ICD diagnosis codes and structured data. These diagnoses are validated by clinician chart review, which is considered the gold standard for confirming true cases from the EHR. The purpose of the study was to explore obstacles that clinicians encounter when using chart review to validate heart failure diagnoses from the EHR.

METHODS: In prior work, a team of eight clinicians performed chart review to validate heart failure diagnosis based on the "Universal Definition of Heart Failure." A portion of the charts were reviewed by two independent reviewers, and we assessed inter-rater reliability using Cohen's kappa (κ). We conducted a content analysis of documents from the clinician chart review to understand challenges in validating EHR-based definitions of heart failure.

RESULTS: Clinicians reviewed 528 charts, with a κ of 0.62 among the 35% of charts with double review. In qualitative analysis, we identified two overarching themes related to challenges in validation of heart failure: 1) challenges in applying the Universal Definition of Heart Failure to real-world patient data, and 2) EHR interoperability and usability barriers impacting validation of heart failure diagnoses.

CONCLUSIONS: Our study highlights clinical and technological limitations of clinician chart review for identifying heart failure patients. This has implications for patient care, quality improvement, and population health. Policies and digital solutions aimed at improving EHR data collection, organization, and data extraction are needed.

AI.tldr: 8名临床医生复核528份病历验证心衰诊断，双人复核部分一致性仅中等（κ=0.62），主要障碍在于通用定义难以套用真实世界数据及EHR互操作性与可用性不足。
AI.motivation: 利用EHR开展临床运营、质量改进与研究时，常通过ICD诊断编码和结构化数据识别心衰患者，而临床医生病历复核被视为确认真实病例的金标准；但复核过程中遇到哪些障碍尚不清楚，本研究即为此展开探索。
AI.method: 基于既往工作的质性研究：8名临床医生依据《心衰通用定义》对EHR病历进行复核以验证心衰诊断，其中部分病历由两名独立复核者背对背评估，采用Cohen's kappa评价复核者间一致性；并对复核过程产生的文档进行内容分析，以归纳验证中的挑战。
AI.result: 共复核528份病历，其中35%为双人复核，复核者间一致性κ=0.62（中等）。质性分析归纳出两大主题：一是将《心衰通用定义》应用于真实世界患者数据存在困难；二是EHR互操作性与可用性障碍影响心衰诊断的验证。摘要未报告各主题的具体例数或比例。
AI.conclusion: 研究提示，依赖临床医生病历复核从EHR中识别心衰患者存在临床与技术双重局限，可影响患者诊疗、质量改进与人群健康管理；需要政策与数字化方案改进EHR的数据采集、组织与提取。本研究为单中心性质性分析，未报告诊断编码的敏感度、特异度等定量验证指标，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
背景：为了在临床运营、质量改进和研究中有效利用电子健康记录（EHR），通常通过ICD诊断代码和结构化数据来识别患有特定临床状况（如心力衰竭）的患者。这些诊断通过临床医生病历审查进行验证，而病历审查被视为从EHR中确认真实病例的金标准。本研究旨在探讨临床医生在使用病历审查验证EHR中心力衰竭诊断时遇到的障碍。

方法：在先前的工作中，一个由八名临床医生组成的团队根据“心力衰竭通用定义”进行病历审查以验证心力衰竭诊断。部分病历由两名独立审查者进行审查，我们使用Cohen's kappa（κ）评估了评分者间信度。我们对临床医生病历审查的文件进行了内容分析，以了解验证基于EHR的心力衰竭定义所面临的挑战。

结果：临床医生审查了528份病历，在35%的双重审查病历中，κ值为0.62。在定性分析中，我们确定了与心力衰竭验证挑战相关的两个主要主题：1）将心力衰竭通用定义应用于真实世界患者数据的挑战，以及2）影响心力衰竭诊断验证的EHR互操作性和可用性障碍。

结论：我们的研究突出了临床医生病历审查在识别心力衰竭患者方面的临床和技术局限性。这对患者护理、质量改进和人口健康具有意义。需要旨在改善EHR数据收集、组织和数据提取的政策和数字解决方案。

title: Biventricular Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy: Diagnostic Insights from Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance.
summary: • ACM is an uncommon but important cause of chest pain. • ACM should be suspected in individuals presenting with VAs. • Echocardiography should be the initial screening tool for ACM. • Three-dimensional TTE or CMR may be considered if clinical suspicion of ACM persists. • CMR plays a crucial role in diagnosing and risk-stratifying ACM.

AI.tldr: 本文为影像与标测教学病例：双心室致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）可表现为胸痛，对出现室性心律失常者应怀疑ACM，CMR在诊断与危险分层中起关键作用。
AI.motivation: ACM是胸痛的不常见但重要病因，临床易漏诊；既往对以胸痛起病、伴室性心律失常的患者如何选择影像学筛查路径缺乏清晰梳理，本文旨在明确CMR在双心室ACM诊断与危险分层中的价值。
AI.method: 本文为CASE期刊的病例教学/综述性文章，非前瞻性研究，摘要未报告研究类型、样本量、干预或暴露、终点定义及统计方法；文中提出疑似ACM者应以超声心动图作为初始筛查工具，临床怀疑持续时可行三维经胸超声心动图或心脏磁共振（CMR）。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果，无效应量、95%置信区间或P值；仅给出要点性结论：ACM是胸痛的不常见但重要病因，出现室性心律失常（VAs）者应怀疑ACM，CMR对ACM的诊断与危险分层至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 临床遇胸痛合并室性心律失常者应将ACM纳入鉴别诊断，超声心动图作为初筛，怀疑持续时升级至三维经胸超声或CMR，CMR是诊断与危险分层的核心工具；本文为教学性总结，缺乏原始数据，结论的循证强度有限，需结合更大样本研究验证。

summary_zh: • 致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）是胸痛一种不常见但重要的病因。• 对于表现为室性心律失常（VAs）的个体，应怀疑ACM。• 超声心动图应作为ACM的初始筛查工具。• 如果临床持续怀疑ACM，可考虑三维经胸超声心动图（TTE）或心脏磁共振（CMR）。• CMR在诊断ACM和对其进行风险分层中起着至关重要的作用。

title: Affordable and Efficient Anatomy Mapping for LBBAP in Dextrocardia With Complete Heart Block
summary: We reported the case of a 77-year-old woman with dextrocardia and complete heart block, demonstrating the effectiveness of simplified anatomical mapping imaging and modified catheter techniques to achieve selective left bundle branch pacing (LBBP).

AI.tldr: 一例77岁右位心合并完全性房室传导阻滞女性患者，采用简化解剖标测成像与改良导管技术成功实现选择性左束支起搏。
AI.motivation: 右位心合并完全性房室传导阻滞患者行左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）时，心脏解剖位置反转、常规标测与导管操作困难，既往缺乏低成本且高效的解剖标测方案报道，本研究旨在探索简化解剖标测成像与改良导管技术的可行性。
AI.method: 单病例报告。研究对象为1例77岁女性右位心合并完全性房室传导阻滞患者。干预为简化解剖标测成像结合改良导管技术，行选择性左束支起搏（LBBP）。终点为手术实施的有效性及选择性LBBP是否成功。摘要未报告具体标测参数、起搏阈值、手术时间及随访数据，亦未说明统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，包括起搏参数、阈值、手术时长、并发症及随访结局；仅描述该技术成功实现选择性左束支起搏，显示其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该病例提示，在右位心合并完全性房室传导阻滞患者中，简化解剖标测成像与改良导管技术可有效完成选择性LBBP，为解剖异常患者提供了一种经济、可行的起搏策略。但证据仅来自单例报告，缺乏对照与随访数据，尚需更多病例验证其可重复性与长期安全性。

summary_zh: 我们报告了一例77岁女性右位心合并完全性心脏传导阻滞的病例，展示了简化的解剖标测成像与改良导管技术对实现选择性左束支起搏（LBBP）的有效性。

title: The Deubiquitinase UCHL1 Drives Susceptibility to Atrial Fibrillation by Stabilizing CaMKII-δ
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a common arrhythmia associated with calcium (Ca2+) dysregulation. Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II-δ (CaMKII-δ) links Ca2+ handling to arrhythmogenesis, but whether deubiquitination regulates its stability in AF remains unclear. We established an AF model by infusing angiotensin II (Ang II) for 3 weeks in atrial cardiomyocyte-specific ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase L1 (UCHL1)-knockout (CKO) and recombinant adeno-associated virus serotype 9 (rAAV9)-UCHL1-overexpressing mice. UCHL1 was markedly upregulated in atria from Ang II-infused mice and patients with AF. UCHL1-CKO attenuated Ang II-induced atrial remodeling and AF susceptibility, reduced CaMKII-δ stability, and improved Ca2+ handling, whereas UCHL1 overexpression produced the opposite effects. Mechanistically, UCHL1 bound to and deubiquitinated CaMKII-δ at K251, preventing proteasomal degradation and thereby enhancing ryanodine receptor type 2 (RyR2) phosphorylation and Ca2+ mishandling. The ubiquitination-deficient CaMKII-δ-K251R mutant aggravated AF, whereas CaMKII-δ knockdown or inhibition reduced the proarrhythmic effects of UCHL1 overexpression. Furthermore, the UCHL1 inhibitor 6RK73 reduced AF inducibility in mice. These findings identify UCHL1-mediated stabilization of the CaMKII-δ-RyR2 axis as a mechanism of AF and support UCHL1 as a potential therapeutic target.

AI.tldr: 去泛素化酶UCHL1通过稳定CaMKII-δ增强RyR2磷酸化与钙处理异常，驱动房颤易感性；抑制UCHL1可减少房颤诱发。
AI.motivation: 房颤与钙处理异常相关，CaMKII-δ是连接钙处理与心律失常的关键分子，但去泛素化是否调控其稳定性及其在房颤中的作用尚不清楚，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 研究采用Ang II输注3周建立房颤小鼠模型，使用心房肌细胞特异性UCHL1敲除（CKO）小鼠和rAAV9-UCHL1过表达小鼠；检测UCHL1表达、心房重构、房颤易感性、CaMKII-δ稳定性与钙处理，并验证K251位点去泛素化机制及UCHL1抑制剂6RK73的效果。
AI.result: Ang II输注小鼠和房颤患者心房中UCHL1显著上调；UCHL1-CKO减轻Ang II诱导的心房重构和房颤易感性，降低CaMKII-δ稳定性并改善钙处理，而过表达UCHL1则相反。机制上UCHL1结合CaMKII-δ K251位点去泛素化，阻止蛋白酶体降解，增强RyR2磷酸化和钙处理异常；CaMKII-δ-K251R突变加重房颤，敲低或抑制CaMKII-δ可减弱UCHL1过表达的促心律失常效应；UCHL1抑制剂6RK73降低小鼠房颤可诱发性。摘要未报告具体效应量和P值。
AI.conclusion: UCHL1介导的CaMKII-δ-RyR2轴稳定是房颤的新机制，UCHL1是潜在治疗靶点；但研究限于动物模型，临床转化需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）是一种与钙（Ca2+）调节异常相关的常见心律失常。Ca2+/钙调蛋白依赖性蛋白激酶II-δ（CaMKII-δ）将Ca2+处理与心律失常发生联系起来，但去泛素化是否调节其在AF中的稳定性仍不清楚。我们通过向心房心肌细胞特异性泛素C末端水解酶L1（UCHL1）敲除（CKO）小鼠和重组腺相关病毒血清型9（rAAV9）-UCHL1过表达小鼠输注血管紧张素II（Ang II）3周，建立了AF模型。在Ang II输注小鼠和AF患者的心房中，UCHL1显著上调。UCHL1-CKO减轻了Ang II诱导的心房重构和AF易感性，降低了CaMKII-δ稳定性，并改善了Ca2+处理，而UCHL1过表达则产生相反效应。机制上，UCHL1在K251位点与CaMKII-δ结合并使其去泛素化，阻止蛋白酶体降解，从而增强兰尼碱受体2型（RyR2）磷酸化和Ca2+处理异常。泛素化缺陷的CaMKII-δ-K251R突变体加重了AF，而CaMKII-δ敲低或抑制则减少了UCHL1过表达的促心律失常效应。此外，UCHL1抑制剂6RK73降低了小鼠的AF可诱发性。这些发现确定了UCHL1介导的CaMKII-δ-RyR2轴稳定化是AF的一种机制，并支持UCHL1作为潜在的治疗靶点。

title: Associations between Atrial Fibrillation and Bone Mineral Density at Different Sites: A Mendelian Randomization Study
summary: Background: Observational studies have suggested that anti-osteoporosis therapies may increase the risk of atrial fibrillation (AF); however, whether bone mineral density (BMD) itself exerts a causal effect on AF remains unclear. This study systematically investigated the univariable causal relationship between AF and BMD at different skeletal sites, including the femoral neck, lumbar spine, forearm, and total body, to clarify the relationship between bone status and AF risk. Methods: We conducted a two-sample univariable Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis to evaluate the causal associations between AF and BMD measured at the femoral neck (FN-BMD), lumbar spine (LS-BMD), forearm (FA-BMD), and total body (TB-BMD). Summary statistics were obtained from large-scale genome-wide association studies (GWASs). The inverse variance-weighted (IVW) method was used as the primary method, with sensitivity analyses including Cochran’s Q test, the MR-Egger intercept test, and leave-one-out analyses. Results: The IVW analysis indicated positive associations of FN-BMD (odds ratio [OR] = 1.17, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.05–1.29, P = 0.003) and FA-BMD (OR = 1.15, 95% CI: 1.03–1.29,nbsp; P = 0.01) with an increased AF risk. In contrast, lumbar spine bone mineral density (LS‑BMD) had a suggestive causal association with AF(OR = 1.12, 95% CI: 1.02‑1.23, P = 0.014).In contrast, no significant associations were detected for TB-BMD (OR = 1.02, 95% CI: 0.95–1.09, P = 0.64). Sensitivity analyses supported the robustness of these findings. Conclusion: This MR study provides genetic evidence that increased FN-BMD and FA-BMD is causally associated with an increased risk of AF, whereas lumbar spine bone mineral density (LS‑BMD) exerted a suggestive causal effect, whereas total‑body bone mineral density (TB‑BMD) showed no significant causal effect.. These results highlight novel links between skeletal health and cardiovascular disease.

AI.tldr: 孟德尔随机化研究显示，股骨颈和桡骨骨密度升高与房颤风险增加存在因果关联，而全身骨密度无显著影响。
AI.motivation: 观察性研究提示抗骨质疏松治疗可能增加房颤风险，但骨密度本身对房颤的因果作用尚不明确，既往证据存在混杂和反向因果的局限。
AI.method: 采用两样本单变量孟德尔随机化分析，基于大规模全基因组关联研究的汇总数据，评估房颤与股骨颈、腰椎、桡骨及全身骨密度的因果关联。以逆方差加权法为主要方法，并辅以Cochran Q检验、MR-Egger截距检验和留一法进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 逆方差加权分析显示，股骨颈骨密度（OR=1.17，95%CI 1.05–1.29，P=0.003）和桡骨骨密度（OR=1.15，95%CI 1.03–1.29，P=0.01）与房颤风险增加正相关；腰椎骨密度呈提示性因果关联（OR=1.12，95%CI 1.02–1.23，P=0.014）；全身骨密度无显著关联（OR=1.02，95%CI 0.95–1.09，P=0.64）。敏感性分析支持结果稳健。
AI.conclusion: 遗传学证据表明，股骨颈和桡骨骨密度升高与房颤风险增加存在因果关联，腰椎骨密度呈提示性效应，全身骨密度无显著因果影响。这提示骨骼健康与心血管疾病之间存在新联系，但研究限于遗传预测的骨密度，临床转化需进一步验证。
